sentence: Likita ya gaya wa ɗan kasuwa cewa lafiya ta fi kuɗi muhimmanci.
translation: The doctor told the trader that health matters more than money does.

sentence: Mahaifiyata tana addu'a kullum a asibiti har sai ɗan'uwana ya samu lafiya.
translation: My mother prays at the hospital every single day until my brother gets his health back.

sentence: Gwamnati ta yi alkawarin gyara hanyar da ke kaiwa ƙauyenmu.
translation: The government promised to repair the road that runs out to our village.

sentence: Ya yi shekara ashirin yana aiki a ma'aikatar gwamnati kafin ya yi ritaya.
translation: He spent twenty years working in a government ministry before he retired.

sentence: Matasan garin sun fusata don gwamnati ba ta biya malaman makaranta ba.
translation: The young men of the town were furious because the government hadn't paid the schoolteachers.

sentence: Ɗana ya cika shekara biyar yau, mun sayo masa sabon keke.
translation: My son turned five today, so we bought him a new bicycle.

sentence: Mun yi shekara goma a wannan unguwa, amma ba mu san maƙwabtanmu ba.
translation: We've been ten years in this neighbourhood and still don't know our neighbours.

sentence: Bayan shekara uku a Legas, ya koma gidansu don ya kula da mahaifiyarsa.
translation: After three years in Lagos he went back to the family house to look after his mother.

sentence: Ar! Na manta da wayata a cikin motar haya, ta riga ta tafi.
translation: Damn it! I left my phone in the taxi and it's already driven off.

sentence: Ar! Wutar lantarki ta tafi kafin in gama buga rahoton aiki.
translation: Damn it! The power went out before I could finish typing up the work report.

sentence: Ar! Da na sani ba zan ba shi kuɗina ba tun farko.
translation: Damn it! If I'd known, I'd never have handed him my money in the first place.

sentence: An haife ni a Kano, amma na yi karatun sakandare a kudancin Nijeriya.
translation: I was born in Kano, but I did my secondary schooling down in southern Nigeria.

sentence: Ƙungiyar ƙwallon ƙafa ta Nijeriya ta doke Masar da ci biyu da ɗaya.
translation: Nigeria's football team beat Egypt two goals to one.

sentence: Duk lokacin da na dawo Nijeriya, sai in ji daɗin ƙamshin ruwan sama.
translation: Every time I come back to Nigeria, the smell of the rain delights me.

sentence: Kawuna ya kawo mana busasshen kifi daga arewacin Najeriya lokacin sallah.
translation: My uncle brought us dried fish from northern Nigeria at the time of the festival.

sentence: Najeriya tana da harsuna sama da ɗari biyar, ba Hausa kaɗai ba.
translation: Nigeria has more than five hundred languages, not just Hausa.

sentence: Ya bar Najeriya shekara goma da suka wuce, amma yana kewar abokansa.
translation: He left Nigeria ten years ago, but he still misses his friends.

sentence: Jaki shi ne bisa mafi amfani a ƙauyenmu, yakan kwaso mana ruwa.
translation: The donkey is the most useful pack animal in our village; it hauls our water for us.

sentence: Fatake sun ɗaura kayan gishiri a jikin bisa kafin su kama hanya.
translation: The traders lashed the loads of salt onto the pack animal before setting off.

sentence: Ban taɓa ganin bisa da ya ɗauki kaya masu nauyi kamar raƙumi ba.
translation: I have never seen a pack animal carry loads as heavy as a camel does.

sentence: Ɗan'uwana yana zaune a Amurka, yakan aiko mana da kuɗi kowane wata.
translation: My brother lives in America and sends us money every month.

sentence: Ta samu gurbin karatu a Amurka, amma tana jin tsoron sanyin hunturu.
translation: She got a place to study in America, but she's dreading the winter cold.

sentence: Bayan shekara biyar a Amurka, ya gwammace ya dawo gida ya buɗe shago.
translation: After five years in America, he decided he'd rather come home and open a shop.

sentence: Iyalinmu sun ƙaura zuwa arewa domin neman ƙasar noma mai kyau.
translation: Our family moved up north looking for good farmland.

sentence: Direban mota ya ce hanyar arewa ta fi aminci a lokacin damina.
translation: The driver said the northern road is safer during the rainy season.

sentence: Ina kewar arewa, inda iskar hunturu takan kawo ƙura kowace safiya.
translation: I miss the north, where the Harmattan wind brings dust every morning.

sentence: Wata mace tana sayar da koko kusa da masallaci kowace safiya.
translation: A woman sells millet porridge beside the mosque every morning.

sentence: Mace ce ta fara buɗe shago a wannan titi shekaru goma da suka wuce.
translation: It was a woman who opened the first shop on this street ten years ago.

sentence: Ita mace ce mai ƙarfin hali, ta ɗauki nauyin iyalinta bayan mijinta ya rasu.
translation: She is a strong woman; she carried the whole family after her husband died.

sentence: Gwamna ya ziyarci asibitin ƙauyenmu, amma bai ga likita ko ɗaya ba.
translation: The governor visited our village clinic, but he did not find a single doctor there.

sentence: Sabon gwamna ya yi alkawarin gyara hanyar da ta lalace tun bara.
translation: The new governor promised to repair the road that has been ruined since last year.

sentence: Mazauna garin sun daina amincewa da gwamna bayan ya karya alkawarinsa.
translation: The townspeople stopped trusting the governor after he broke his promise.

sentence: A kasuwarmu, mutane sukan yi muhawara game da mulki har rana ta faɗi.
translation: In our market people argue about government until the sun goes down.

sentence: Jam'iyyar ta yi shekara takwas tana mulki kafin masu ƙuri'a su kore ta.
translation: The party spent eight years in power before the voters threw it out.

sentence: Mulki ba ya dawwama; kowane sarki yakan sauka daga karagarsa a ƙarshe.
translation: Power does not last forever; every ruler steps down from his seat in the end.

sentence: Maƙwabcinmu musulmi ne, kuma yakan gayyace mu wajen buɗa baki a Ramadan.
translation: Our neighbour is a Muslim, and he invites us over to break the fast in Ramadan.

sentence: Kowane musulmi a unguwarmu yakan halarci sallar Juma'a a babban masallaci.
translation: Every Muslim in our neighbourhood attends Friday prayers at the main mosque.

sentence: Ya zama musulmi bara, kuma yanzu yana koyon karatun Alƙur'ani da ƙwazo.
translation: He became a Muslim last year, and now he is learning to recite the Qur'an with real diligence.

sentence: Jirgin ƙasa daga Abuja zuwa Kaduna yakan cika da fasinjoji kowace safiya.
translation: The train from Abuja to Kaduna fills up with passengers every morning.

sentence: Na yi shekara uku ina karatu a Kaduna kafin in koma gida Kano.
translation: I studied in Kaduna for three years before moving back home to Kano.

sentence: Duk lokacin da na isa Kaduna, sai in ji ƙamshin suya daga gefen titi.
translation: Every time I reach Kaduna, I catch the smell of grilled meat from the roadside.

sentence: Mai sayar da agogon ya ce ba boko ba ne, amma ya lalace washegari.
translation: The watch seller said it was not a fake, but it broke the very next day.

sentence: Kada ka biya kuɗi kafin ka ga kayan, domin boko ya yawaita a yanzu.
translation: Don't pay before you have seen the goods, because there is so much fraud these days.

sentence: Na fusata sosai da na gane cewa alkawarin da ya yi mini boko ne.
translation: I was furious when I realised the promise he made me was nothing but a trick.

sentence: Rigar da mahaifiyata ta ɗinka min tana da kyau fiye da wadda na saya.
translation: The gown my mother sewed for me is lovelier than the one I bought.

sentence: Shugaban makaranta ya ce halin yaron yana da kyau amma karatunsa ya yi rauni.
translation: The headmaster said the boy's character is good but his schoolwork has gone weak.

sentence: Ban taɓa ganin kyau irin na faɗuwar rana a bakin kogin Neja ba.
translation: I have never seen beauty like the sunset on the bank of the River Niger.

sentence: Wani kare ya bi ni har gida, sai na ba shi ragowar abinci.
translation: A dog followed me all the way home, so I gave it the leftover food.

sentence: Mafarauta sukan tafi daji da kare domin ya taimaka musu bin sawu.
translation: Hunters go into the bush with a dog so it can help them follow tracks.

sentence: Yara sun ji tsoro sosai lokacin da babban kare ya tsallake shingen gidan.
translation: The children were terrified when a big dog jumped over the compound wall.

sentence: Mun shanya tufafi da safe, rana kuwa ta busar da su kafin azahar.
translation: We hung the washing out in the morning, and the sun had dried it before the noon prayer.

sentence: Manoma sukan huta a ƙarƙashin bishiya har sai rana ta karkata da yamma.
translation: Farmers rest under a tree until the sun sinks towards evening.

sentence: Rana ta yi zafi ƙwarai a yau, har na kasa fita kasuwa.
translation: The sun was so fierce today that I could not even go out to the market.

sentence: Mahaifina ya ce mana cin riba haram ne, don haka ya ƙi rancen banki.
translation: My father told us that taking interest is forbidden, so he turned down the bank loan.

sentence: Limami ya yi waʼazi a masallaci cewa yaudarar mutane haram ce a kasuwa.
translation: The imam preached in the mosque that cheating people in the market is a sin.

sentence: Ta ƙi karɓar kuɗin caca, tana cewa ba za ta ci haram ba.
translation: She refused to take the gambling money, saying she would not live off something forbidden.

sentence: Kakata ta tara kuɗi shekaru goma kafin ta tafi aikin hajji a Maka.
translation: My grandmother saved up for ten years before she went on the pilgrimage to Mecca.

sentence: Mahajjata sun dawo daga Maka da dabino, suka raba wa maƙwabtansu.
translation: The pilgrims came back from Mecca with dates and shared them out among their neighbours.

sentence: Ina fatan wata rana in ga Kaʼaba a Maka da idanuna.
translation: I hope that one day I will see the Kaaba in Mecca with my own eyes.

sentence: Malam ya rubuta misali ɗaya a allo kafin ya ba mu aikin gida.
translation: The teacher wrote one example on the board before giving us our homework.

sentence: Shugaban ƙungiyarmu ya ba da misali na wani gari da ya magance matsalar ruwa.
translation: The head of our association gave the example of a town that solved its water problem.

sentence: Ubana ya kasance misali na haƙuri, ko da kasuwancinsa ya faɗi.
translation: My father was an example of patience, even when his business collapsed.

sentence: Annabi Ibrahim ya yi haƙuri sosai saʼad da aka jefa shi cikin wuta.
translation: The Prophet Abraham showed great endurance when he was thrown into the fire.

sentence: Ibrahim ya kwana yana gyara babur ɗinsa don ya kai kaya gobe.
translation: Ibrahim stayed up all night repairing his motorbike so he could deliver goods tomorrow.

sentence: Mun sa wa ɗanmu suna Ibrahim, muna fatan ya gaji karimcin kakansa.
translation: We named our son Ibrahim, hoping he would inherit his grandfather's generosity.

sentence: Ban gane darasin ba, sai na roƙi malam ya sake yin bayani.
translation: I hadn't understood the lesson, so I asked the teacher to go through the explanation again.

sentence: Likita ya yi mana bayani mai sauƙi game da magungunan da ya rubuta.
translation: The doctor gave us a simple explanation of the medicines he had prescribed.

sentence: A taron unguwa, ya yi bayani mai tsawo amma bai gamsar da kowa ba.
translation: At the neighbourhood meeting he gave a long explanation, but it satisfied nobody.

sentence: Bishiyar mangwaro da ke bayan gida ta yi girma fiye da rufin ɗakinmu.
translation: The mango tree behind the house has grown taller than the roof of our room.

sentence: A ƙauyenmu, ana ba sarki girma sosai duk lokacin da ya shiga taro.
translation: In our village the chief is shown great respect whenever he walks into a gathering.

sentence: Girma ba komai ba ne; ƙaramin shagonsa ya fi shagonsu riba.
translation: Size is nothing: his little shop makes more profit than their big one.

sentence: ʼYan sanda suna ci gaba da bincike kan sacewar shanun makiyaya.
translation: The police are still pursuing their investigation into the theft of the herders' cattle.

sentence: Ta shafe watanni uku tana yin bincike a ƙauyuka kafin ta rubuta kundinta.
translation: She spent three months doing research out in the villages before writing her thesis.

sentence: Kafin na sayi filin, na yi bincike sosai don gudun matsalar gado.
translation: Before I bought the plot I looked into it carefully, to avoid an inheritance dispute.

sentence: Muna shirin tafiya zuwa gidan kakata a ƙauye gobe da safe.
translation: We are getting ready for the trip to my grandmother's house in the village tomorrow morning.

sentence: Tafiya daga Kano zuwa Sokoto a cikin motar haya ta gajiyar da mu.
translation: The journey from Kano to Sokoto in a hired car wore us out completely.

sentence: Ban taɓa mantawa da tafiya ta farko da na yi a jirgin ƙasa ba.
translation: I have never forgotten the first journey I ever made by train.

sentence: Zamani ya canja; yanzu yara suna koyon girki a waya maimakon wurin uwa.
translation: Times have changed: children now learn to cook from their phones instead of from their mothers.

sentence: A wannan zamani, kowane gida a unguwarmu yana da injin janareta.
translation: In this day and age, every house in our neighbourhood has a generator.

sentence: Malaminmu ya kwatanta zamanin mulkin mallaka da zamani na yanzu a darasin tarihi.
translation: In the history lesson our teacher compared the colonial era with the present day.

sentence: Kakana yakan zauna a ƙarƙashin bishiyar kuka yana shan koko kowace safiya.
translation: My grandfather sits under the baobab tree drinking millet porridge every morning.

sentence: Bayan ya yi ritaya, ya koma ƙauye ya zauna kusa da gonarsa.
translation: After he retired he moved back to the village and settled right beside his farm.

sentence: Ba na son birni; na fi son in zauna a ƙauye da iyalina.
translation: I don't care for the city; I would much rather live in the village with my family.

sentence: Wannan tukunya ta tsufa, amma mahaifiyata ba ta son mu canza ta.
translation: This pot is worn out, but my mother won't hear of us replacing it.

sentence: Wannan ita ce hanyar da za ta kai ka kasuwa kafin ruwa ya sauka.
translation: This is the road that will get you to the market before the rain comes down.

sentence: Wannan ne karo na uku da malamin ya maimaita tambayar, amma babu amsa.
translation: This is the third time the teacher has repeated the question, and still nobody answers.

sentence: Yaron ya ɓace a kasuwa, sai na same shi kusa da tashar mota.
translation: The boy got lost in the market, and I found him near the motor park.

sentence: Malamin ya kira shi a gaban aji domin ya karanta wasiƙar da ƙarfi.
translation: The teacher called him up to the front of the class to read the letter aloud.

sentence: Kowa ya juya mini baya, amma shi ya zauna tare da ni har asuba.
translation: Everyone turned their back on me, but he stayed with me until dawn.

sentence: Na fito daga gida da sassafe kafin kowa ya farka a unguwarmu.
translation: I left the house at first light, before anyone in our neighbourhood had woken up.

sentence: Kayan sun iso daga Kano da motar dare, sai muka sauke su.
translation: The goods arrived from Kano on the night lorry, so we unloaded them.

sentence: Tun daga ranar da ya bar gari, ban sami labarinsa ba ko kaɗan.
translation: From the day he left town, I have not had a word of news about him.

sentence: Ka rufe ƙofar da kyau kafin ka kwanta, don iska tana shiga.
translation: Shut the door properly before you go to bed — the wind is getting in.

sentence: Idan ka isa ofis da wuri, ka gaida shugaban kafin taron ya fara.
translation: If you get to the office early, greet the boss before the meeting starts.

sentence: Ban yarda da kai ba, domin ka ƙaryata ni a gaban abokaina jiya.
translation: I don't trust you, because you called me a liar in front of my friends yesterday.

sentence: Mahaifiyata ta zuba mai a tukunya kafin ta soya kifin da muka saya.
translation: My mother poured oil into the pot before frying the fish we had bought.

sentence: Direban ya sayi mai a tasha kafin ya kama hanyar Kano da safe.
translation: The driver bought fuel at the station before setting off for Kano in the morning.

sentence: Farashin mai ya tashi sosai, don haka mutane sun daina tafiye-tafiye.
translation: The price of fuel has shot up, so people have stopped travelling.

sentence: Bari mu ɗauko fitila, domin wutar lantarki ta yanke tun da yamma.
translation: Let's fetch the lamp — the power has been off since the evening.

sentence: Za mu tashi da asuba domin mu isa gona kafin rana ta yi zafi.
translation: We'll set out at dawn so that we reach the farm before the sun gets hot.

sentence: Sun yi mana magana da mugun murya, amma ba mu amsa musu ba.
translation: They spoke to us in a harsh voice, but we did not answer them back.

sentence: Kakata takan ce Allah ya kawo sauƙi duk lokacin da muka yi korafi.
translation: My grandmother says may God bring relief every time we complain about something.

sentence: Manoma sun taru suna roƙon Allah ya saukar da ruwan sama kan gonakinsu.
translation: The farmers gathered to beg God to send rain down on their fields.

sentence: Na yi alkawari cewa in Allah ya ba ni lafiya, zan koma makaranta.
translation: I made a promise that if God grants me health, I will go back to school.

sentence: Yanzu na gama wanke kwanoni, sai kuma a ce in dafa abinci.
translation: I have only just finished washing the dishes, and now they tell me to cook.

sentence: Har yanzu ba a gyara hanyar ba, don haka motocin sukan makale da yamma.
translation: The road still hasn't been repaired, so the cars get stuck there every evening.

sentence: A da ba ya son makaranta, amma yanzu yakan yi karatu har tsakar dare.
translation: He used to hate school, but now he studies right up to the middle of the night.

sentence: Yara sun yi wasan ƙwallo a bayan gidan har sai da dare ya yi.
translation: The children played football behind the house until night fell.

sentence: Bayan mun gama girbi, sai muka kai amfanin gona kasuwar Lahadi.
translation: After we finished the harvest, we took the produce to the Sunday market.

sentence: Bayan shekaru goma a ƙasar waje, ya dawo bai san kowa a unguwar ba.
translation: After ten years abroad, he came home and knew nobody left in the neighbourhood.

sentence: Muna zama a wani ƙaramin ɗaki kusa da kasuwa, amma muna jin daɗin unguwar.
translation: We live in a small room near the market, but we're fond of the neighbourhood.

sentence: Malaman sun gaji da zama a otal, sai suka nemi gida a garin.
translation: The teachers grew tired of staying in a hotel, so they looked for a house in town.

sentence: Ban taɓa jin daɗin zama a birni ba, saboda hayaniyar ba ta ƙarewa.
translation: I have never enjoyed living in the city, because the noise never lets up.

sentence: Hajiya ta ɗaura ɗankwali a kanta kafin ta fita zuwa kasuwa.
translation: Hajiya tied a headscarf on her head before heading out to the market.

sentence: Malama Zainab ta gina wannan makarantar da kanta, ba tare da taimakon kowa ba.
translation: Malama Zainab built this school herself, without anyone's help.

sentence: Bayan ta faɗi jarrabawa, ta zauna a ɗaki tana zargin kanta.
translation: After she failed the exam, she sat in her room blaming herself.

sentence: Uwa ta tashi da sassafe don ta dafa koko kafin yara su tafi makaranta.
translation: Mother got up at dawn to make koko before the children left for school.

sentence: Duk ƴan uwa sun taru a gidan kakata domin bikin suna.
translation: All the relatives gathered at my grandmother's house for the naming ceremony.

sentence: Ba na jin akwai wanda zai maye gurbin uwa a rayuwar mutum.
translation: I don't think anyone can take a mother's place in a person's life.

sentence: Malamin ya ba mu labarin Annabi Yusufu a lokacin darasin Alƙurʼani.
translation: The teacher told us the story of the Prophet Yusuf during the Qur'an lesson.

sentence: Kakana yakan yi mana waʼazi game da rayuwar Annabi kowace Jumaʼa.
translation: My grandfather preaches to us about the Prophet's life every Friday.

sentence: A ganina, kowane annabi ya zo da saƙo mai sauƙi ga mutanensa.
translation: To my mind, every prophet came with a simple message for his people.

sentence: Gidanmu yana kusa da masallaci, don haka muna jin kiran sallah sosai.
translation: Our house is near the mosque, so we hear the call to prayer clearly.

sentence: Ka tsaya kusa da ni a kasuwa domin kada ka ɓace cikin taron.
translation: Stay close to me in the market so you don't get lost in the crowd.

sentence: Yana ba ni haushi cewa babu asibiti kusa da ƙauyenmu har yau.
translation: It annoys me that there is still no hospital anywhere near our village.

sentence: Malam ya bayyana mana yadda Allah ya halicci Adam daga ƙasa.
translation: The teacher explained to us how God created Adam out of earth.

sentence: Likitocin nan suna kula da kowane ɗan adam ba tare da bambanci ba.
translation: The doctors here look after every human being without discrimination.

sentence: Kowane ɗan adam yakan yi kuskure, don haka ya kamata mu yafe wa juna.
translation: Every human being makes mistakes, so we ought to forgive one another.

sentence: Malamai suna karanta tarihin Annabi Muhammadu a lokacin bikin Maulidi kowace shekara.
translation: The scholars recite the life of the Prophet Muhammad at the Maulid festival every year.

sentence: Muhammadu ya sayar da shanunsa a kasuwar Wudil don ya biya kuɗin makaranta.
translation: Muhammadu sold his cattle at Wudil market so he could pay the school fees.

sentence: Sun sa wa ɗansu suna Muhammadu domin suna girmama Annabi sosai.
translation: They named their son Muhammadu because they hold the Prophet in deep respect.

sentence: Na yi mamaki lokacin da na ga ƙanwata ta iso daga Legas.
translation: I was astonished when I saw my younger sister arrive from Lagos.

sentence: Abin mamaki, direban mota ya ƙi karɓar kuɗin da muka ba shi.
translation: Surprisingly, the driver refused to take the money we handed him.

sentence: Duk ƙauyen ya cika da mamaki bayan ƴan makaranta suka gina rijiya.
translation: The whole village was filled with amazement after the schoolchildren dug a well.

sentence: Maƙwabciyarmu ta yi mana alheri, ta kula da yaranmu lokacin da muke asibiti.
translation: Our neighbour did us a kindness and looked after our children while we were at the hospital.

sentence: A garinmu, mukan yi wa baƙi alheri ko da muna cikin ƙunci.
translation: In our town we treat strangers well even when we are in hardship.

sentence: Na roƙi Allah ya saka wa malamina da alheri saboda taimakonsa.
translation: I prayed that God would reward my teacher with good for his help.

sentence: Gadon nan sabo ne, amma ya riga ya fara yin ƙara da dare.
translation: This bed is new, but it has already started creaking at night.

sentence: Aikin nan sabo ne a gare ni, don haka ina yawan tambayar abokan aiki.
translation: This job is new to me, so I am forever asking my colleagues questions.

sentence: Na fi son tsohon gidanmu, ko da yake wannan sabo ne kuma babba.
translation: I prefer our old house, even though this one is new and big.

sentence: Kowace safiya nakan kai ƙanena makaranta kafin in tafi wurin aiki.
translation: Every morning I take my little brother to school before I head to work.

sentence: Bayan an gyara rufin, ɗalibai sun koma makaranta a makon jiya.
translation: After the roof was repaired, the pupils went back to school last week.

sentence: Tun da na fara makaranta a Kano, ban taɓa jin daɗin karatun lissafi ba.
translation: Ever since I started school in Kano, I have never enjoyed maths lessons.

sentence: Ban sami lokacin dafa abinci ba, don haka mun sayi tuwo a kasuwa.
translation: I didn't get the time to cook, so we bought tuwo at the market.

sentence: Malam ya ce mu zo da ƙarfe takwas, amma lokacin taron ya canja.
translation: The teacher told us to come at eight, but the time of the meeting was changed.

sentence: Lokaci yana tafiya da sauri, sai ka ga ƙaramin yaro ya zama uba.
translation: Time moves fast — before you know it, the little boy has become a father.

sentence: Yaron ya karya tasa, amma ya faɗi gaskiya kafin mahaifiyarsa ta tambaya.
translation: The boy broke a dish, but he told the truth before his mother even asked.

sentence: Shugaban ƙauyen ya nemi gaskiya daga kowa kafin ya yanke hukunci.
translation: The village head asked everyone for the truth before he gave his ruling.

sentence: Gaskiya ba ta ɓacewa, ko da mutane sun yi shekaru suna ɓoye ta.
translation: The truth never gets lost, even if people spend years hiding it.

sentence: Da ruwan sama ya fara, kowa ya shiga ɗaki ya bar farfajiya.
translation: When the rain started, everyone went inside and left the courtyard empty.

sentence: A wurin bikin, kowa ya ci abinci sai wanda ya makara.
translation: At the wedding everyone got food except the one who turned up late.

sentence: Kowa yana da matsalarsa, saboda haka ka yi haƙuri da abokan aikinka.
translation: Everyone has troubles of their own, so be patient with the people you work with.

sentence: Kakata ba ta jin Turanci, sai Hausa muke yi a gida.
translation: My grandmother doesn't understand English, so Hausa is all we speak at home.

sentence: Sabon likitan ya koyi Hausa da sauri, yanzu yana magana da marasa lafiya.
translation: The new doctor learned Hausa quickly, and now he talks to the patients himself.

sentence: Ban gane Hausar wannan karin magana ba, sai kakana ya bayyana maʼanarta.

translation: Farmers in Niger State are worried because this year's rain has not been enough.

sentence: Da rana ta karkata zuwa yamma, muka san lokacin sallar laʼasar ya yi.
translation: Once the sun had leaned toward the west, we knew it was time for the afternoon prayer.

sentence: Ka bi hanyar nan zuwa yamma har sai ka ga babban masallaci.
translation: Follow this road westwards until you see the big mosque.

sentence: Guguwa ta taso daga yamma, sai mutanen ƙauye suka fara tattara kayansu.
translation: A dust storm rose up out of the west, and the villagers started gathering their things.

sentence: Ruwan sama ya jiƙe komai, hatta katifar da muke kwana a kai.
translation: The rain soaked everything, even the mattress we sleep on.

sentence: Kowa ya halarci bikin auren, hatta maƙwabcinmu mai fushi ya zo.
translation: Everyone attended the wedding; even our bad-tempered neighbour turned up.

sentence: Farashin kayan abinci ya tashi ƙwarai, hatta gero da masara sun yi tsada.
translation: Food prices have shot up; even millet and maize have become expensive.

sentence: Na faɗi daga keke, gwiwata ta yi jini har na kasa tafiya.
translation: I fell off the bicycle, and my knee bled so badly that I couldn't walk.

sentence: Likita ya gaya wa ɗan wasan cewa gwiwarsa tana buƙatar hutun wata guda.
translation: The doctor told the player that his knee needed a month's rest.

sentence: Gwiwar kakata tana ciwo lokacin sanyi, sai ta kasa hawa matakala.
translation: My grandmother's knee aches in the cold weather, and then she can't climb the stairs.

sentence: Maƙwabta sun ba mu taimako lokacin da gidanmu ya ci wuta.
translation: The neighbours gave us help when our house caught fire.

sentence: Ina buƙatar taimakonka wajen ɗaga buhun shinkafa kafin ruwan sama ya sauka.
translation: I need your help lifting the sack of rice before the rain comes down.

sentence: Taimakon da gwamnati ta bayar bai isa waɗanda ambaliya ta shafa ba.
translation: The aid the government provided was not enough for those hit by the flood.

sentence: Kowace Asabar mahaifiyata takan kai mu kasuwar Kurmi da safe.
translation: Every Saturday my mother takes us to Kurmi market in the morning.

sentence: Bikin auren ƙanwata zai gudana ranar Asabar mai zuwa a Kano.
translation: My younger sister's wedding will be held next Saturday in Kano.

sentence: Asabar ce ranar da na fi so, domin ba a zuwa makaranta.
translation: Saturday is the day I like best, because nobody goes to school.

sentence: Malamin Alƙur'ani yana koya wa yara karatu a farfajiyar gidanmu kowace yamma.
translation: The Qur'an teacher teaches the children to read in our courtyard every evening.

sentence: Sabon malamin lissafi ya ba mu aikin gida mai wuya jiya.
translation: The new maths teacher gave us difficult homework yesterday.

sentence: Ina girmama wannan malami sosai domin bai taɓa ƙin amsa tambayoyinmu ba.
translation: I respect that teacher deeply, because he has never refused to answer our questions.

sentence: Da na iso birnin Kano, hayaniyar kasuwa ta ba ni mamaki.
translation: When I reached the city of Kano, the din of the market astonished me.

sentence: Mahaifina ya bar ƙauyenmu ya koma birni don neman aikin yi.
translation: My father left our village and moved to the city to look for work.

sentence: Rayuwa a birni tana da tsada ƙwarai, amma aikin yi ya fi samuwa.
translation: Life in the city is very expensive, but work is easier to come by.

sentence: Ubana yakan tashi kafin alfijir domin ya je gonar dawa da wuri.
translation: My father usually gets up before dawn so as to reach the sorghum farm early.

sentence: Uban amaryar ya karɓi sadaki a gaban shaidu biyu a masallaci.
translation: The bride's father received the bride-price before two witnesses at the mosque.

sentence: Bayan rasuwar ubansa, ya ɗauki nauyin duk iyalin ba tare da gunaguni ba.
translation: After his father died, he shouldered the whole family without a word of complaint.

sentence: Malam Bello ya wallafa littafi kan tarihin Sokoto bayan shekaru goma.
translation: Malam Bello wrote a book on the history of Sokoto after ten years.

sentence: Jaridar ta wallafa labarin ambaliyar ruwa kafin gwamnati ta ce komai.
translation: The newspaper published the flood story before the government said anything at all.

sentence: Ina fatan zan wallafa waƙoƙina wata rana, ko da a ƙaramar mujalla ce.
translation: I hope to publish my poems one day, even if only in a small magazine.

sentence: Ɗan'uwana ya koma Legas ya buɗe ƙaramin shago a Oshodi.
translation: My brother moved to Lagos and opened a small shop in Oshodi.

sentence: Titunan Legas sun cika da mota har muka kwana kan hanya.
translation: The streets of Lagos were so choked with cars that we spent the night on the road.

sentence: An ce Legas gari ne na arziki, amma ni na ga wahala kawai.
translation: They say Lagos is a city of wealth, but all I saw there was hardship.

sentence: Kakana ya rataye tsohon baka da kwari a bangon ɗakinsa.
translation: My grandfather hung the old bow and quiver on the wall of his room.

sentence: Maƙeri ya yanke sandar ƙarfen da baka cikin mintuna kaɗan.
translation: The blacksmith cut the iron rod through with a hacksaw in a few minutes.

sentence: Mafarauta a ƙauyenmu sun daina amfani da baka tun bindiga ta shigo.
translation: The hunters in our village stopped using the bow once guns arrived.

sentence: Mahaifiyata ta shirya kaiwar hatsi da mai domin bikin suna gobe.
translation: My mother put together a return-gift of grain and oil for tomorrow's naming ceremony.

sentence: Kaiwar da makwabciyarmu ta yi mana a bara, yau mun saka mata.
translation: The gift our neighbour brought us last year, today we have repaid her for it.

sentence: Kaiwa ba kyauta ba ce kawai, domin dole ka mayar da irinta wata rana.
translation: A kaiwa is not simply a present, because one day you must send back its like.

sentence: Editan jaridar ya yanke sakin layi biyu daga rahoton nawa jiya.
translation: The newspaper's editor cut two paragraphs out of my report yesterday.

sentence: Ƙanwata tana aiki a matsayin edita a gidan rediyon Kaduna yanzu.
translation: My younger sister works as an editor at the Kaduna radio station now.

sentence: Na fusata da editan saboda ya sauya taken rubutuna ba tare da izinina ba.
translation: I was furious with the editor because he changed the title of my piece without my permission.

sentence: A gida muna magana da Hausa, amma yara suna karatu da Turanci a makaranta.
translation: At home we speak Hausa, but the children study in English at school.

sentence: Dole in koyi Turanci sosai kafin in nemi aiki a babban banki.
translation: I have to learn English properly before I apply for a job at a big bank.

sentence: Ina jin kunya lokacin da nake magana da Turanci a gaban baƙi.
translation: I feel embarrassed whenever I speak English in front of strangers.

sentence: Bayan mutuwar kakana, shugabancin gidanmu ya koma hannun babban baffana.
translation: After my grandfather died, leadership of our household passed to my eldest uncle.

sentence: Malamai sun koka cewa babu shugabanci nagari a makarantar tun bara.
translation: The teachers complained that the school has had no proper leadership since last year.

sentence: Shugabanci ba wasa ba ne, sai ka jure zargin mutane kowace rana.
translation: Leadership is no joke — you have to put up with people's criticism every single day.

sentence: Mun tashi daga Kano da ƙarfe biyar, muka isa Sakkwato kafin magariba.
translation: We left Kano at five o'clock and reached Sokoto before the sunset prayer.

sentence: Masu sayar da kayan fata daga Sakkwato sukan zo kasuwarmu ranar Litinin.
translation: The leather traders from Sokoto come to our market every Monday.

sentence: Duk lokacin da na ziyarci Sakkwato, zafin rana yakan hana ni barci.
translation: Every time I visit Sokoto, the heat stops me from sleeping.

sentence: Ka yanka mini yanki ɗaya daga wannan kankana, ina jin ƙishirwa.
translation: Cut me one slice off this watermelon — I'm really thirsty.

sentence: Gwamna ya ziyarci kowane yanki na jihar kafin zaɓen bana.
translation: The governor toured every district of the state before this year's election.

sentence: Wannan yanki ba shi da asibiti, sai mu yi tafiya awa biyu.
translation: This district has no hospital — we have to travel two hours to reach one.

sentence: Mahaifina ya yi shekara ashirin yana sayar da kifi a Maiduguri.
translation: My father spent twenty years selling fish in Maiduguri.

sentence: Motar da za ta tafi Maiduguri ta lalace, sai muka kwana a Potiskum.
translation: The bus bound for Maiduguri broke down, so we ended up spending the night in Potiskum.

sentence: Duk da wahalar da muka sha, ban taɓa mantawa da kyawun Maiduguri ba.
translation: For all the hardship we went through, I have never forgotten how lovely Maiduguri is.

sentence: Kakata takan tashi da ƙarfe biyar domin ta yi sallar asuba.
translation: My grandmother gets up at five so that she can pray the dawn prayer.

sentence: Da muka ji kiran salla, sai muka rufe shago muka nufi masallaci.
translation: When we heard the call to prayer, we shut the shop and headed for the mosque.

sentence: Idan na yi salla da dare, sai zuciyata ta kwanta bayan wahalar aiki.
translation: When I pray at night, my heart finally settles after the strain of the day's work.

sentence: Yara ba sa yin azumi, amma sukan taimaka wajen dafa abincin buɗa baki.
translation: Children don't fast, but they help cook the meal for breaking the fast.

sentence: A watan azumi, mukan tashi daga aiki da ƙarfe biyu don mu huta.
translation: In the month of fasting we knock off work at two o'clock so we can rest.

sentence: Azumin bana ya yi mini wuya sosai saboda zafin rana da yunwa.
translation: This year's fast was really hard on me, what with the heat and the hunger.

sentence: Ɗana ya kammala makarantar firamare bara, yanzu yana neman gurbin sakandare.
translation: My son finished primary school last year, and now he's looking for a place at a secondary school.

sentence: Ina koyar da lissafi a makarantar firamare da ke bayan kasuwarmu.
translation: I teach arithmetic at the primary school behind our market.

sentence: Har yanzu ban manta da malamin firamare da ya koya mini karatu ba.
translation: I still haven't forgotten the primary-school teacher who taught me to read.

sentence: Mahaifiyata ta sada ni da wata ƙawarta da ke sayar da kayan ɗinki.
translation: My mother introduced me to a friend of hers who sells sewing supplies.

sentence: Aikin hajji ya sada ni da wani malami daga Nijar a Makka.
translation: The hajj brought me together with a scholar from Niger while we were in Mecca.

sentence: Ina fatan Allah ya sada mu da iyayenmu lafiya bayan wannan doguwar tafiya.
translation: I pray God brings us back safely to our parents after this long journey.

sentence: Da baba ya dawo daga gona, sai ya nemi ruwan sha mai sanyi.
translation: When Dad got back from the farm, he asked for some cold drinking water.

sentence: Baba, ka yi haƙuri, motar ta ƙi tashi, zan makara kaɗan.
translation: Sorry, sir — the car wouldn't start, so I'm going to be a little late.

sentence: Tun bayan rasuwar baba, gidan bai sake yin daɗi kamar da ba.
translation: Since Dad passed away, the house has never felt the way it used to.

sentence: Miji da mata suna zaune a farfajiya suna cin abincin dare tare.
translation: Husband and wife are sitting out in the courtyard eating supper together.

sentence: Ta samu miji a birni, saboda haka ta bar aikinta a ƙauye.
translation: She found a husband in the city, so she gave up her job back in the village.

sentence: Kowace mace tana son miji mai haƙuri wanda yake mutunta iyayenta.
translation: Every woman wants a patient husband, one who shows respect to her parents.

sentence: Kowace shekara mukan kai yara Zariya su ziyarci kakarsu.
translation: Every year we take the children to Zaria to visit their grandmother.

sentence: Ƙanena yana karatun aikin gona a jamiʼar da ke Zariya.
translation: My younger brother is studying agriculture at the university in Zaria.

sentence: Ban manta da ranar da motarmu ta lalace a hanyar Zariya ba.
translation: I haven't forgotten the day our car broke down on the road to Zaria.

sentence: Duk lokacin da wutar lantarki ta katse, ʼyata takan yi kuka don tsoro.
translation: Every time the power cuts out, my daughter starts crying out of fear.

sentence: Direban motar haya ya ce babu tsoro, amma fasinjoji sun yi ta adduʼa.
translation: The taxi driver said there was nothing to fear, but the passengers kept praying.

sentence: Tsoro ya sa na yi shiru, ko da yake na san gaskiyar lamarin.
translation: Fear made me keep quiet, even though I knew the truth of the matter.

sentence: Maƙwabcinmu bahaushe ne, kuma yakan kawo mana kayan marmari daga kasuwa.
translation: Our neighbour is a Hausa man, and he often brings us fruit from the market.

sentence: Sabon abokin aikina bahaushe ne daga Katsina, yana koya mini karin magana.
translation: My new colleague is a Hausa man from Katsina, and he is teaching me proverbs.

sentence: Ko da yake ni ba bahaushe ba ne, ina jin daɗin alʼadun Kano ƙwarai.
translation: Even though I'm not a Hausa man myself, I thoroughly enjoy the customs of Kano.

sentence: Bayan dogon nazari, mun yanke shawarar sayen gida a wajen birnin.
translation: After a long investigation, we decided to buy a house outside the city.

sentence: Malamai za su yi nazari kan dalilin da ya sa ɗalibai ke barin makaranta.
translation: The teachers will carry out research into why pupils are dropping out of school.

sentence: Rahoton kwamitin ya yi rauni domin an rubuta shi ba tare da nazari ba.
translation: The committee's report is weak because it was written without any real research.

sentence: Wallahi ban taɓa cin tuwo mai daɗi kamar na kakata ba.
translation: I swear to God, I have never eaten tuwo as good as my grandmother's.

sentence: Ka yi haƙuri, wallahi zan biya bashin gobe idan albashi ya shigo.
translation: Please bear with me — by God, I'll pay the debt tomorrow once my salary comes in.

sentence: Ban gaskata ba sai da ya ce wallahi bai ɗauki kuɗin ba.
translation: I didn't believe it until he swore by God that he hadn't taken the money.

sentence: Kafin fitowar rana, kakana yakan fitar da shanu zuwa makiyaya.
translation: Before sunrise, my grandfather takes the cattle out to the grazing ground.

sentence: Ranar kasuwa, mahaifina ya sayar da shanu biyu don ya biya kuɗin makaranta.
translation: On market day my father sold two cows so he could pay the school fees.

sentence: Na firgita lokacin da shanu suka cika hanya, sai direba ya tsaya cak.
translation: I panicked when the cattle filled the road and the driver stopped dead.

sentence: Da safe mahaifina yakan haye kogin da komi zuwa gonarsa.
translation: In the morning my father crosses the river by canoe to reach his farm.

sentence: Masunta sun ɗaura komi a bakin kogi, suna jiran ruwa ya sauka.
translation: The fishermen tied the canoe up at the riverbank, waiting for the water to drop.

sentence: Komi ya jijjiga a tsakiyar kogi, sai muka riƙe juna muka yi shiru.
translation: The canoe rocked in the middle of the river, so we held on to each other and fell silent.

sentence: Mun yi tafiya kilomita hamsin kafin mu isa ƙauyen kakanmu.
translation: We travelled fifty kilometres before we reached our grandfather's village.

sentence: Mahaifina ya yi shekara hamsin yana koyar da yara a wannan makarantar.
translation: My father spent fifty years teaching children in this very school.

sentence: Mutum hamsin sun halarci bikin auren ʼyar uwata, amma ban san rabinsu ba.
translation: Fifty people came to my sister's wedding, but I didn't know half of them.

sentence: Likita ya gargaɗi kakana ya rage gishiri saboda hawan jininsa.
translation: The doctor warned my grandfather to cut down on salt because of his blood pressure.

sentence: Mun jira likita fiye da awa biyu a asibitin gwamnati jiya.
translation: We waited more than two hours for the doctor at the government hospital yesterday.

sentence: Ina son in zama likita don in taimaki ƙauyen da ba shi da asibiti.
translation: I want to become a doctor so I can help the village that has no hospital.

sentence: Kowace Jumaʼa mahaifina yakan tafi masallaci da wuri don ya sami sahun farko.
translation: Every Friday my father goes to the mosque early so he can get a spot in the front row.

sentence: Mun tara kuɗi a unguwa domin gyara rufin masallaci kafin damina ta zo.
translation: We collected money around the neighbourhood to fix the mosque roof before the rains come.

sentence: Sautin karatun Alƙurʼani daga masallaci yakan kwantar mini da hankali da yamma.
translation: The sound of Qur'an recitation from the mosque settles my mind in the evening.

sentence: Sanyin Jos ya sa mahaifiyata ta kwashe dukkan bargunan gida cikin akwati.
translation: The cold in Jos made my mother pack every blanket in the house into a suitcase.

sentence: Kowace Asabar mahaifina yakan sayo dankalin turawa a kasuwar Terminus da ke Jos.
translation: Every Saturday my father buys Irish potatoes at Terminus market in Jos.

sentence: Na fi son zama a Jos, domin zafinsa bai kai na Kano ba.
translation: I would rather live in Jos, because its heat is nothing like Kano's.

sentence: Ɗana ya dage sai na saya masa ƙwallo, har ya ƙi cin abinci.
translation: My son kept insisting until I bought him a ball; he even refused to eat.

sentence: Kwamitin ya dage taron zuwa mako mai zuwa saboda rashin wutar lantarki.
translation: The committee put the meeting off to next week because there was no electricity.

sentence: Ko da yake iyayenta sun ƙi amincewa, ta dage kan karatun likitanci.
translation: Even though her parents refused to agree, she stuck stubbornly to studying medicine.

sentence: Mahaifiyata ta ware waken da ya lalace kafin ta zuba shi a tukunya.
translation: My mother picked out the spoiled beans before she tipped them into the pot.

sentence: Gwamnati ta ware naira miliyan goma domin gyaran hanyar da ruwa ya lalata.
translation: The government set aside ten million naira to repair the road the floods destroyed.

sentence: Kada ku ware sabon yaron daga wasanninku don kawai baƙo ne.
translation: Don't shut the new boy out of your games just because he is a stranger.

sentence: A watan Disamba mukan koma ƙauye domin bukukuwan aure da girbi.
translation: In December we usually go back to the village for the weddings and the harvest.

sentence: Kamfanin zai biya mu albashin Disamba kafin ranar ashirin ga wata.
translation: The company will pay us the December salary before the twentieth of the month.

sentence: Ina jin tsoron watan Disamba, domin hazo yakan hana mu tuƙi da daddare.
translation: I dread December, because the harmattan haze stops us from driving at night.

sentence: Ƙanwata ta gaya mini wani asiri, amma ban faɗa wa kowa ba.
translation: My younger sister told me a secret, but I haven't told anyone.

sentence: Kowane kamfani yana da asiri da ba ya son abokan hamayyarsa su sani.
translation: Every company has a secret it doesn't want its rivals to find out.

sentence: Mutanen ƙauye sun yi imani cewa mafaraucin yana da asiri na ɓacewa.
translation: The villagers believe that the hunter owns a charm that makes him vanish.

sentence: Gidan da muka haya a Kano babba ne, amma ɗakin girkinsa ƙarami ne.
translation: The house we rented in Kano is big, but its kitchen is tiny.

sentence: Tun da yake shi ne babba a cikinmu, kowa yakan saurari shawararsa.
translation: Since he is the eldest among us, everyone listens to his advice.

sentence: Matsalar bana babba ce ƙwarai, domin manoma sun fara sayar da shanunsu.
translation: This year's trouble is a serious one, because farmers have started selling off their cattle.

sentence: Mahaifiyata ta yanke hukunci cewa ba za mu ƙara zuwa wurin wasan ba.
translation: My mother ruled that we would not be going to the game centre any more.

sentence: Alƙali ya yanke hukunci mai tsauri kan wanda ya saci kuɗin marayu.
translation: The judge handed down a harsh sentence on the man who stole the orphans' money.

sentence: A ganina hukunci irin wannan ba zai hana mutane sata ba ko kaɗan.
translation: In my view a sentence like that will not stop people stealing at all.

sentence: Kakata ta tafi Saudiyya domin aikin hajji, za ta dawo bayan sati uku.
translation: My grandmother has gone to Saudi Arabia for the hajj; she comes back in three weeks.

sentence: Yayana yana aiki a Saudiyya, yakan aiko mana da kuɗi kowane wata.
translation: My elder brother works in Saudi Arabia, and he sends us money every month.

sentence: Ban taɓa tsammanin zafin Saudiyya zai fi na Sakkwato tsanani ba.
translation: I never imagined the heat in Saudi Arabia would be worse than Sokoto's.

sentence: Manjo Bello ya umarci sojojin da su kwashe kayansu kafin faɗuwar rana.
translation: Major Bello ordered the soldiers to pack up their gear before sunset.

sentence: Kawuna ya yi shekara goma a aikin soja kafin a naɗa shi manjo.
translation: My uncle served ten years in the army before he was made a major.

sentence: Sojoji suna girmama Manjo Aliyu, domin ya taɓa cetonsu daga harin ʼyan bindiga.
translation: The soldiers hold Major Aliyu in high regard, because he once saved them from a bandit attack.

sentence: Bayan zaɓen bara, an naɗa Aisha minista mai kula da harkokin ilimi.
translation: After last year's election, Aisha was appointed the minister in charge of education.

sentence: A talabijin mun ga minista yana rarraba taki ga manoma a Kano.
translation: On television we saw the minister handing out fertiliser to farmers in Kano.

sentence: Mutanen garin ba su gamsu da minista ba tun bayan ziyararsa ta ƙarshe.
translation: The people of the town have not been happy with the minister since his last visit.

sentence: Bayan mun gama cin abinci, kakana ya ɗaga hannu ya ce alhamdulillahi.
translation: After we finished eating, my grandfather raised his hand and said alhamdulillah.

sentence: Likita ya ce yaron ya sami sauƙi, sai mahaifiyarsa ta ce alhamdulillahi.
translation: The doctor said the boy was getting better, so his mother said alhamdulillah.

sentence: Na yi shekara guda ina neman aiki, yanzu na same shi, alhamdulillahi.
translation: I spent a whole year looking for work, and now I have found it, praise be to God.

sentence: Ciwon kai ya kama ni tun safe, don haka ban je makaranta ba.
translation: A headache came over me first thing this morning, so I did not go to school.

sentence: Duk lokacin da damina ta zo, gwiwar kakana takan yi ciwo sosai.
translation: Every time the rainy season arrives, my grandfather's knee aches badly.

sentence: Malamin ya tafi asibiti saboda ciwon da ya daɗe yana damunsa.
translation: The teacher went to the hospital because of the illness that had been troubling him for a long time.

sentence: A ranar Jumaʼa, malam ya yi waʼazi kan rayuwar Manzon Allah.
translation: On Friday the malam preached about the life of the Messenger of God.

sentence: Sarki ya aika da manzo zuwa ƙauyen don ya isar da saƙo.
translation: The emir sent a messenger out to the village to deliver a message.

sentence: Ban gaskata manzon ba, domin saƙon da ya kawo bai yi daidai ba.
translation: I did not believe the messenger, because the message he brought did not add up.

sentence: Kakata takan ce duniya wasa ce, amma lahira ita ce gaskiya.
translation: My grandmother always says this world is a game, but the afterlife is the real thing.

sentence: A makarantar allo, malam ya gargaɗe mu cewa za a tambaye mu a lahira.
translation: At the Qurʼanic school, the malam warned us that we will be questioned in the afterlife.

sentence: Tun da mahaifinsa ya koma lahira, shi ke kula da iyalin gidan.
translation: Since his father passed on to the next world, he is the one looking after the household.

sentence: Da muka isa gidan kawuna, sai ya buɗe ƙofa yana ta cewa maraba.
translation: When we reached my uncle's house, he opened the door saying welcome over and over.

sentence: Shugaban makarantar ya tashi tsaye ya ce wa baƙin maraba da zuwa Kano.
translation: The head of the school stood up and told the visitors, welcome to Kano.

sentence: Duk lokacin da na dawo ƙauyen, kakata takan yi mini maraba da murmushi.
translation: Whenever I come back to the village, my grandmother welcomes me with a smile.

sentence: Bayan labaran ƙarfe bakwai, gidan rediyon ya kawo sharhi kan zaɓe mai zuwa.
translation: After the seven o'clock news, the radio station ran a commentary on the coming election.

sentence: Malamin ya rubuta sharhi mai tsawo a gefen aikin da na miƙa masa.
translation: The teacher wrote a long comment in the margin of the work I handed in to him.

sentence: Sharhin da ya rubuta a shafin sada zumunta ya ɓata wa mutane rai.
translation: The comment he wrote on social media upset a lot of people.

sentence: Malama Hauwa tana koyar da ilimin lissafi a makarantar sakandare ta ƙauyenmu.
translation: Mrs. Hauwa teaches mathematics at the secondary school in our village.

sentence: Malamar da ke koyar da ʼyata Alƙurʼani takan zo gidanmu kowace Asabar.
translation: The teacher who teaches my daughter the Qurʼan comes to our house every Saturday.

sentence: Duk ɗaliban aji uku suna girmama malamar saboda haƙurin da take yi da su.
translation: All the third-year students respect the teacher because of the patience she shows them.

sentence: Malam ya ba mu labarin yadda Annabi Nuhu ya gina babban jirgin ruwa.
translation: The malam told us the story of how the Prophet Noah built the great boat.

sentence: Yara suna son labarin Annabi Nuhu domin dabbobi sun shiga jirgi biyu-biyu.
translation: Children love the story of the Prophet Noah because the animals boarded the ark two by two.

sentence: Nuhu ya sayar da shanunsa a kasuwar Wudil don ya biya kuɗin makaranta.
translation: Nuhu sold his cattle at the Wudil market so that he could pay the school fees.

sentence: Ruwan sama ya rushe gadar da muke bi zuwa kasuwa kowace Litinin.
translation: The rain washed away the bridge we take to the market every Monday.

sentence: Maʼaikatan gwamnati sun fara gina sabuwar gada a kan kogin Kaduna.
translation: Government workers have started building a new bridge over the Kaduna River.

sentence: Kowace safiya nakan tsaya kan gada ina kallon masunta a cikin kogin.
translation: Every morning I stop on the bridge and watch the fishermen down in the river.

sentence: Da daren Ramadan, malam ya tunatar da mu cewa Allah yana saukar da rahama.
translation: On a night in Ramadan, the malam reminded us that God sends down His mercy.

sentence: Da muka ji mutuwar maƙwabcinmu, sai muka ce Allah ya yi masa rahama.
translation: When we heard that our neighbour had died, we said may God have mercy on him.

sentence: Alƙalin ya nuna rahama ga saurayin, ya rage masa hukuncin zuwa wata uku.
translation: The judge showed mercy to the young man and cut his sentence down to three months.

sentence: Tun da mahaifina ya yi rashin lafiya, ina tallafa masa da kuɗin magani.
translation: Ever since my father fell ill, I've been helping him out with money for his medicine.

sentence: Ƙungiyar mata a unguwarmu tana tallafa wa marayu da kayan makaranta kowace shekara.
translation: The women's association in our neighbourhood supports orphans with school supplies every year.

sentence: Ba na son a tallafa mini, amma yau na kasa biyan kuɗin haya.
translation: I hate being helped out, but today I couldn't cover the rent.

sentence: Gashin kan kakana ya yi fari duka tun bara, amma ƙarfinsa bai ragu ba.
translation: My grandfather's hair went completely white last year, but his strength hasn't faded at all.

sentence: Dokin da sarki ya hau ranar Sallah fari ne kamar auduga.
translation: The horse the emir rode on Sallah day was as white as cotton.

sentence: Ina son a yi wa ɗakina fenti fari, domin yana sa zuciya ta kwanta.
translation: I want my room painted white, because it settles the mind.

sentence: Da na shiga shago, sai maigidan ya ce mini, "Barka da zuwa, malam."
translation: As I stepped into the shop, the owner said to me, "Welcome, sir."

sentence: Kowace rana makwabciyarmu takan tsaya ta ce, "Barka da safiya," kafin ta wuce kasuwa.
translation: Every day our neighbour stops to say "Good morning" before carrying on to the market.

sentence: Ranar Sallah mukan yi wa juna "Barka da Sallah" har muryarmu ta ƙare.
translation: On Sallah day we wish each other "Happy Sallah" until our voices give out.

sentence: Ɗan uwana yana zaune a Gana, yana sayar da kayan lantarki a Accra.
translation: My brother lives in Ghana, selling electronics in Accra.

sentence: Mun tashi daga Kano da mota har Gana, tafiyar ta ɗauki kwana biyu.
translation: We set out from Kano by road all the way to Ghana; the journey took two days.

sentence: Duk lokacin da Najeriya ta kara da Gana a ƙwallo, gida yakan yi hayaniya.
translation: Whenever Nigeria play Ghana at football, the whole house is in uproar.

sentence: Malamin ya sa mu haddace aya guda biyar kafin darasin gobe.
translation: The teacher made us memorise five verses before tomorrow's lesson.

sentence: Liman ya karanta aya mai tsawo, mutane suka daɗe suna tsaye a sallah.
translation: The imam recited a long verse, and the congregation stood a good while in prayer.

sentence: Duk sa'ad da na ji wannan aya, sai hawaye su zubo mini.
translation: Every time I hear that verse, the tears start coming.

sentence: Ilimi hakki ne na kowane yaro, ko a ƙauye yake zaune.
translation: Education is the right of every child, even one living out in a village.

sentence: Malamai sun yi zanga-zanga suna cewa hakki ne su karɓi albashi kan lokaci.
translation: The teachers marched, saying it is their right to be paid on time.

sentence: Ban ji daɗi ba da aka hana ni hakki a gadon mahaifina.
translation: It cut me deeply to be denied my due in my father's inheritance.

sentence: Kakana ya ba wa ɗan farinsa suna Yakubu, kamar yadda mahaifinsa ya yi.
translation: My grandfather named his firstborn Yakubu, just as his own father had done.

sentence: Injiniya Yakubu ya gyara janareton makarantar kafin jarrabawar ta fara.
translation: Engineer Yakubu repaired the school's generator before the examinations began.

sentence: Labarin Annabi Yakubu da ya rasa ɗansa yakan sa mutane su yi kuka.
translation: The story of the Prophet Jacob losing his son always sets people weeping.

sentence: Ruwan sama yakan fara sauka a nan tun tsakiyar watan Mayu.
translation: The rains here usually start falling from the middle of May.

sentence: An sa ranar aurenmu a ƙarshen Mayu, kafin damina ta tsananta.
translation: They set our wedding for the end of May, before the rainy season gets heavy.

sentence: Ban taɓa mantawa da watan Mayu na shekarar da muka rasa gonarmu ba.
translation: I have never forgotten the May of the year we lost our farm.

sentence: Yara sukan hau kan ganuwa su yi ta kallon kasuwar da ke ƙasa.
translation: The children climb up onto the town wall and gaze down at the market below.

sentence: Ma'aikatan gwamnati suna gyara ganuwa domin jan hankalin masu yawon buɗe ido.
translation: Government workers are repairing the old town wall to attract tourists.

sentence: Kakana yakan ce ganuwa ce ta tsare garinmu lokacin yaƙe-yaƙen dā.
translation: My grandfather used to say it was the wall that kept our town safe in the wars of old.

sentence: Sun haƙa kabari kafin rana ta faɗi, kamar yadda al'ada ta ce.
translation: They dug the grave before sunset, just as custom requires.

sentence: Ba a barin ciyawa ta rufe kabari a ƙauyenmu; muna share shi kowane wata.
translation: In our village no grave is left to the weeds; we clear it every month.

sentence: Duk lokacin da na tsaya gaban kabarin mahaifina, sai maganata ta ƙare.
translation: Every time I stand before my father's grave, my words dry up.

sentence: Iskar hamada tana kawo ƙura cikin gida duk lokacin rani.
translation: The desert wind blows dust into the house all through the dry season.

sentence: Direban mota ya ɓata hanya a tsakiyar hamada har dare ya yi.
translation: The driver lost his way in the middle of the desert until night fell.

sentence: Ina son hamada da yamma, domin iska takan yi sanyi bayan rana ta faɗi.
translation: I love the desert in the evening, because the wind turns cool once the sun goes down.

sentence: Ɗan uwana ya koma Saliyo bayan ya kammala karatunsa a Kano.
translation: My brother went back to Sierra Leone after he finished his studies in Kano.

sentence: Kamfaninmu yana sayen zinari daga Saliyo tun shekaru goma da suka wuce.
translation: Our company has been buying gold from Sierra Leone for the past ten years.

sentence: Ban taɓa zuwa Saliyo ba, amma ina fatan ganin tekunta wata rana.
translation: I have never been to Sierra Leone, but I hope to see its coast one day.

sentence: Mahaifiyata takan sayi dankalin Turawa na Filato a kasuwa duk ranar Asabar.
translation: My mother buys Plateau potatoes at the market every Saturday.

sentence: An tura ɗan uwana aikin koyarwa a wata makaranta cikin duwatsun Filato.
translation: My brother was posted to teach at a school up in the hills of Plateau.

sentence: Sanyin Filato ya fi na Kano tsanani, shi ya sa nake son zuwa can.
translation: The cold in Plateau bites harder than Kano's, and that is exactly why I like going there.

sentence: Bayan ruwan sama, gonar mahaifina ta koma kore duk inda ka duba.
translation: After the rains, my father's farm turned green wherever you looked.

sentence: Malamin ya ce mu yi gyara da alƙalami mai launin kore kawai.
translation: The teacher told us to make our corrections with a green pen only.

sentence: A wurina, kore shi ne launin da na fi so tun ina yaro.
translation: For me, green has been my favourite colour ever since I was a boy.

sentence: Tun tana budurwa, mahaifiyata takan taimaka wa kakarta wajen dafa abinci.
translation: Back when she was a young unmarried girl, my mother used to help her grandmother with the cooking.

sentence: Budurwar da ke sayar da kayan lambu a kasuwarmu ta san kowa.
translation: The young woman who sells vegetables in our market knows everybody there.

sentence: Ita budurwa ce mai hankali, don haka iyayenta ba sa damuwa da ita.
translation: She is a sensible young woman, so her parents do not worry about her.

sentence: Mun sauka a Gusau da ƙarfe biyu, sai muka nemi masauki.
translation: We got down at Gusau at two o'clock and then went looking for somewhere to stay.

sentence: Kakana yana sayar da fatun shanu a kasuwar Gusau kowace Litinin.
translation: My grandfather sells cowhides at the Gusau market every Monday.

sentence: Hanyar Gusau ta yi muni ƙwarai, don haka na gaji da tafiya a kanta.
translation: The road to Gusau has become terrible, so I am tired of travelling on it.

sentence: Kada ka yi wa ƙaninka zalunci saboda kai ne babba a gida.
translation: Don't bully your little brother just because you are the eldest at home.

sentence: Maʼaikatan sun yi zanga-zanga kan zaluncin da shugaban kamfanin yake yi musu.
translation: The workers protested against the injustice the head of the company was doing to them.

sentence: Ba zan yi shiru ba idan na ga ana zalunci a gaban idona.
translation: I will not keep quiet if I see oppression happening right in front of my eyes.

sentence: Wani bature ya zo unguwarmu yana neman inda zai sayi tuwo.
translation: A European came to our neighbourhood looking for somewhere to buy tuwo.

sentence: Baturen da ke koyar da mu Turanci ya iya Hausa fiye da ni.
translation: The European who teaches us English speaks Hausa better than I do.

sentence: Ba kowane bature ne mai kuɗi ba, wasu ma talakawa ne kamarmu.
translation: Not every European is rich; some of them are poor people just like us.

sentence: Kakata ta tafi aikin hajji a Makka shekarar da ta wuce.
translation: My grandmother went on the hajj in Mecca last year.

sentence: Muna fuskantar Makka duk lokacin da muka tsaya sallah a masallaci.
translation: We face Mecca every time we stand up for prayer in the mosque.

sentence: Ina fatan wata rana zan ziyarci Makka tare da iyalina duka.
translation: I hope that one day I will visit Mecca together with my whole family.

sentence: Mahaifina yakan karanta mana hadisi guda ɗaya bayan sallar magariba.
translation: My father reads us a single hadith after the sunset prayer.

sentence: Malamin ya bayyana maʼanar hadisin nan a hankali har ɗalibai suka gane.
translation: The teacher explained the meaning of that hadith slowly until the students understood it.

sentence: Wannan hadisi ya taɓa zuciyata, kuma tun ranar ban manta da shi ba.
translation: That hadith touched my heart, and I have not forgotten it since that day.

sentence: Ɗan uwansa ya shafe shekaru uku a kaso kafin a sake shi.
translation: His brother spent three years in prison before they let him out.

sentence: Alƙali ya yanke masa hukuncin zaman kaso na shekaru biyar a Kano.
translation: The judge sentenced him to five years in prison in Kano.

sentence: Ina jin tausayin matarsa, domin mijinta yana zaman kaso tun bara.
translation: I feel sorry for his wife, since her husband has been in prison since last year.

sentence: Haruna ya taimaka mini wajen ɗaukar buhun shinkafa zuwa gida cikin ruwan sama.
translation: Haruna helped me carry the sack of rice home in the rain.

sentence: Na yi mamakin yadda Haruna ya ƙi karɓar kuɗin da na ba shi.
translation: I was amazed that Haruna refused to take the money I offered him.

sentence: Annabi Haruna ya taimaki ɗan uwansa Musa wajen isar da saƙo ga mutane.
translation: The prophet Aaron helped his brother Moses deliver the message to the people.

sentence: Littattafan adabi sun cika ɗakina, har mahaifiyata takan yi ƙorafi a kansu.
translation: Literature books fill my room, so much that my mother keeps complaining about them.

sentence: A makarantar sakandare muna karanta adabin Hausa kowace Talata da safe.
translation: At secondary school we read Hausa literature every Tuesday morning.

sentence: Malaminmu ya ce adabi yana koya mana tarihin mutanenmu fiye da jaridu.
translation: Our teacher says literature teaches us our people's history better than newspapers do.

sentence: Da daddare kura ta shiga garken awaki, ta kashe biyu kafin mu farka.
translation: A hyena got into our goat pen at night and killed two before we woke up.

sentence: Mafarauta sun kafa tarko a bayan gona domin su kama kura.
translation: The hunters set a trap behind the farm so they could catch the hyena.

sentence: Muryar kura da dare tana tsoratar da yara, har suna ƙin fita waje.
translation: The hyena's cry at night frightens the children, so they refuse to go outside.

sentence: Dubban mutane sun taru a filin idi tun kafin gari ya waye.
translation: Thousands of people gathered at the Eid prayer ground before daybreak.

sentence: Ambaliyar ruwa ta lalata dubban gonaki, har manoma suka rasa abincin bana.
translation: The flood destroyed thousands of farms, so the farmers lost this year's food.

sentence: Na kashe dubban naira wajen gyaran motata, amma har yanzu ba ta tashi ba.
translation: I spent thousands of naira repairing my car, and it still won't start.

sentence: Da mahaifinmu ya shiga ɗakin, sai muka yi shiru nan take.
translation: When our father walked into the room, we fell silent at once.

sentence: Bayan alƙali ya shiga, shiru ya mamaye kotun har sai da ya yi magana.
translation: After the judge came in, silence filled the courtroom until he spoke.

sentence: Shiru ya fi magana amfani lokacin da zuciya ta cika da fushi.
translation: Silence serves you better than speech when your heart is full of anger.

sentence: Bil ɗin wutar lantarki na wannan wata ya ninka na watan da ya gabata.
translation: This month's electricity bill is double last month's.

sentence: Mai gidan abincin ya kawo mana bil kafin mu gama cin abinci.
translation: The restaurant owner brought us the bill before we had finished eating.

sentence: Na ƙi biyan bil ɗin, domin an ƙara kuɗi ba tare da sanarwa ba.
translation: I refused to pay the bill, because they raised the charge without any notice.

sentence: Za mu gama gyaran gidan kafin ƙarshen watan Maris mai zuwa.
translation: We will finish repairing the house before the end of this coming March.

sentence: An fara jarrabawar ƙarshe a ranar goma ga watan Maris a makarantarmu.
translation: The final exams start on the tenth of March at our school.

sentence: A watan Maris zafi yakan yi tsanani, har barci ya gagare mu da dare.
translation: In March the heat turns fierce, so much that we cannot sleep at night.

sentence: Mahaifiyata ta aike ni kasuwa in sayo albasa da tattasai domin miya.
translation: My mother sent me to the market to buy onions and peppers for the stew.

sentence: Manoman Sakkwato sun samu riba mai yawa bana, domin albasa ta yi tsada.
translation: The Sokoto farmers made a big profit this year, because onions became expensive.

sentence: Ba na son yanka albasa, domin hawaye kan zubo mini nan take.
translation: I hate slicing onions, because my eyes start streaming straight away.

sentence: Saye da sayarwa yana tafiya sosai a kasuwar Kano kowace Litinin.
translation: Buying and selling goes on briskly in Kano market every Monday.

sentence: Na ga wayar a kasuwa, sai na saye ta da kuɗin albashina.
translation: I saw the phone at the market, so I bought it with my salary.

sentence: Yanzu saye ya yi wahala, domin farashin kayan abinci ya tashi sosai.
translation: Buying anything is hard now, because food prices have risen so much.

sentence: Mahaifiyata ta shuka tumatir a ƙasa mai laushi bayan gidanmu.
translation: My mother planted tomatoes in the soft soil behind our house.

sentence: Ɗan kasuwa ya ajiye buhunan gero a ƙasa har sai motar ta zo.
translation: The trader set the sacks of millet down on the ground until the lorry arrived.

sentence: Ina damuwa domin ƙasa ta bushe, ba mu ga ruwan sama ba tun Afrilu.
translation: I am worried because the earth has dried out — we have not seen rain since April.

sentence: Baba yakan dawo daga ofis da ƙarfe shida, sai ya huta.
translation: Dad usually gets back from the office at six, and then he rests.

sentence: Muna jiran shugaban makaranta a ofis ɗinsa tun ƙarfe takwas na safe.
translation: We have been waiting for the headmaster in his office since eight this morning.

sentence: Ba na son ofis ɗin nan, domin ba shi da taga ko fanka.
translation: I don't like this office, because it has neither a window nor a fan.

sentence: Kowace safiya Aliyu yakan kai shanunsa zuwa makiyaya kafin rana ta yi zafi.
translation: Every morning Aliyu drives his cattle out to the pasture before the sun turns hot.

sentence: An sayar da makiyaya ta ƙauyenmu, yanzu shanu ba su da wurin kiwo.
translation: Our village's grazing land has been sold, and now the cattle have nowhere to graze.

sentence: A ganina, babu makiyaya mai ciyawa kamar wadda take a gefen kogi.
translation: To my mind, no pasture is as grassy as the one down beside the river.

sentence: Ladan ya yi kiran sallar asuba, sai muka tashi daga barci.
translation: The muezzin gave the call for the dawn prayer, and we got up out of bed.

sentence: Mutane sukan zo daga wasu unguwanni domin su ji ladan yana kiran salla.
translation: People come over from other neighbourhoods just to hear the muezzin give the call to prayer.

sentence: Muryar ladan tana ba ni kwanciyar hankali duk lokacin da na ji ta.
translation: The muezzin's voice sets my mind at ease every time I hear it.

sentence: Bayan rasuwar mahaifinsu, yaran sun raba dukiya ba tare da husuma ba.
translation: After their father passed away, the children shared out the property without a single quarrel.

sentence: Ya tara dukiya daga ƙaramin shago har ya gina gidaje uku a Kano.
translation: He built up his wealth from one small shop until he had put up three houses in Kano.

sentence: Kakata takan ce lafiya ta fi dukiya, amma ba mu saurare ta ba.
translation: My grandmother always said health is worth more than wealth, but we never listened to her.

sentence: Ɗan uwana yana karatu a Ingila, yakan kira mu kowane Lahadi.
translation: My brother is studying in England, and he rings us every Sunday.

sentence: Mun taru a gidan kallo don ganin wasan Najeriya da Ingila.
translation: We crowded into the viewing centre to watch the Nigeria versus England match.

sentence: Da farko sanyin Ingila ya ba ni wahala, amma yanzu na saba.
translation: At first the cold in England gave me a hard time, but by now I'm used to it.

sentence: Maƙwabtanmu sun kai ƙarar juna wurin alkali kan iyakar gonaki.
translation: Our neighbours took each other before the judge over the boundary between their farms.

sentence: Alkali ya saurari shaidu biyu kafin ya yanke hukunci a kotun Kano.
translation: The judge heard two witnesses before he delivered his verdict in the Kano court.

sentence: Mutanen garin suna girmama alkali domin ba ya karɓar cin hanci.
translation: The people of the town respect the judge because he does not take bribes.

sentence: Malam ya nuna mana Asiya a taswirar da ke rataye a bango.
translation: The teacher showed us Asia on the map hanging on the wall.

sentence: Yawancin kayan da muke saya a kasuwa daga Asiya suke zuwa.
translation: Most of the goods we buy in the market come from Asia.

sentence: Ina fatan zan ziyarci Asiya wata rana domin ganin manyan biranenta.
translation: I hope to visit Asia one day to see its great cities.

sentence: A watan Yuni ne ruwan sama yakan fara sauka a garinmu.
translation: It is in June that the rains usually start falling in our town.

sentence: An shirya jarrabawar ƙarshe a watan Yuni, don haka ɗalibai ba sa hutu.
translation: The final exams have been set for June, so the students are getting no rest.

sentence: Na yi aure a watan Yuni, har yanzu ina tunawa da ruwan ranar.
translation: I got married in June, and I still remember the rain that fell that day.

sentence: Miyar da mahaifiyata ta dafa ta yi zafi ainun, sai muka sha ruwa.
translation: The soup my mother cooked was extremely hot, so we kept reaching for water.

sentence: Kasuwa ta yi cunkoso ainun kafin Sallah, har muka kasa wucewa.
translation: The market was so terribly crowded before the Sallah festival that we couldn't get through.

sentence: Na gaji ainun bayan tafiyar awa shida a mota daga Kaduna.
translation: I am extremely tired after a six-hour ride from Kaduna.

sentence: Amaryar ta zauna a ɗakinta tana jiran ƴan uwanta su zo.
translation: The bride sat in her room waiting for her relatives to arrive.

sentence: A ranar bikin, amaryar ba ta ci abinci ba saboda kunya.
translation: On the wedding day the bride ate nothing at all, out of shyness.

sentence: Kowa ya ce amaryar Musa ta fi kowace amarya kyau a garinmu.
translation: Everyone said Musa's bride was the loveliest bride in our town.

sentence: Kakana yakan ba mu labarin Dauda da Goliyat kafin mu kwanta.
translation: My grandfather used to tell us the story of David and Goliath before we went to bed.

sentence: A makarantar Lahadi, yara sun rera waƙar Zabura wadda Dauda ya rubuta.
translation: At Sunday school the children sang a psalm that David had written.

sentence: Ina mamakin yadda ƙaramin Dauda ya kayar da babban jarumin nan.
translation: I am amazed at how young David brought down that huge warrior.

sentence: Jamʼiyyun hamayya sun ƙi halartar taron da gwamna ya kira jiya.
translation: The opposition parties refused to attend the meeting the governor called yesterday.

sentence: Hamayya tsakanin ƴan uwa biyu ta lalata kasuwancin da mahaifinsu ya bari.
translation: The rivalry between the two brothers wrecked the business their father had left behind.

sentence: Ba na son hamayyar da ke tsakanin ƙungiyoyin ƙwallo biyu na garinmu.
translation: I don't enjoy the rivalry between our town's two football clubs.

sentence: Mahaifiyata takan zuba zuma a cikin koko idan ina fama da mura.
translation: My mother stirs honey into the pap whenever I'm down with a cold.

sentence: A kasuwar Kano, mun sayi kwalba biyu na zuman daji daga wani makiyayi.
translation: At Kano market we bought two bottles of wild honey from a herder.

sentence: Zuma ta fi sukari zaƙi, kuma likita ya ce tana da amfani ga lafiya.
translation: Honey is sweeter than sugar, and the doctor says it is good for your health.

sentence: A watan Janairu, sanyin hunturu yakan hana mu fita da sassafe.
translation: In January the harmattan cold keeps us from going out early in the morning.

sentence: Makarantar za ta buɗe a ranar goma ga watan Janairu bayan hutu.
translation: The school reopens on the tenth of January, once the holidays are over.

sentence: Tun watan Janairu nake jiran amsar aikin, har yanzu ba su kira ni ba.
translation: I have been waiting for an answer about that job since January, and they still haven't called.

sentence: Masunta sun jefa taru cikin kogin Kwara tun kafin gari ya waye.
translation: The fishermen cast the net into the Niger before daybreak.

sentence: Kakana yana gyaran tarun da ya tsage lokacin da kifi ya yi yawa.
translation: My grandfather is mending the net that tore on the day the catch was heavy.

sentence: Wannan taru ya tsufa sosai, ban yarda zai iya riƙe babban kifi ba.
translation: This net is far too old; I don't believe it could hold a big fish.

sentence: Ɗan uwana ya tafi Birtaniya domin karatun likitanci shekaru uku da suka wuce.
translation: My brother went to Britain to study medicine three years ago.

sentence: A Birtaniya ruwan sama yakan sauka kullum, don haka kowa yana ɗauke da laima.
translation: In Britain it rains day in and day out, so everybody goes about with an umbrella.

sentence: Ina mafarkin ziyartar Birtaniya, amma kuɗin biza ya fi ƙarfin albashina.
translation: I dream of visiting Britain, but the visa fee is beyond what my salary can bear.

sentence: Wata tsaka ta manne a bango tana kallon fitilar da muke kunnawa.
translation: A gecko is clinging to the wall, watching the lamp we light.

sentence: Yara sun tsorata da tsakar da ta faɗo daga rufin ɗakin girki.
translation: The children were startled by the gecko that dropped from the kitchen ceiling.

sentence: Ba na korar tsaka daga gida saboda tana cin sauro da ƙwaro.
translation: I don't chase geckos out of the house, because they eat mosquitoes and other insects.

sentence: Ciroman Kano ya jagoranci hawan sallah tare da mahaya dawakai.
translation: The Ciroma of Kano led the Sallah procession together with the horsemen.

sentence: Sarki ya naɗa ɗansa ciroma a gaban dubban mutane a fadarsa.
translation: The emir installed his son as Ciroma before thousands of people at his palace.

sentence: Mutanen gari sun amince da ciroma, domin yakan sasanta rikicin gado cikin adalci.
translation: The townspeople trust the Ciroma, because he settles inheritance disputes fairly.

sentence: Mutane sun ce warkewarsa karama ce ta Allah, ba maganin likita ba.
translation: People said his recovery was a wonder from God, not the doctor's medicine.

sentence: A watan Ramadan, karamar Malam Sani ta sa kowane maƙwabci ya sami abincin sahur.
translation: During Ramadan, Malam Sani's generosity meant every neighbour had something to eat before dawn.

sentence: Ana yabon karamar attajirin nan, domin yakan biya kuɗin makarantar marayu.
translation: People praise that wealthy man's generosity, since he pays the school fees of orphans.

sentence: Mahaifina yakan kama kifi a bakin Kwara kowace safiya kafin rana ta yi zafi.
translation: My father goes fishing on the bank of the Niger every morning before the sun gets hot.

sentence: A lokacin damina, ruwan Kwara yakan hau ya mamaye gonakin shinkafa.
translation: In the rainy season the Niger rises and swallows the rice farms.

sentence: Har yanzu ina tuna ranar da muka haye Kwara cikin ƙaramin jirgin ruwa.
translation: I still remember the day we crossed the Niger in a tiny boat.

sentence: Kanar ɗin da ke zaune kusa da mu yana shayar da furanninsa kowace safiya.
translation: The colonel who lives next door waters his flowers every single morning.

sentence: Kanar ya umarci sojoji su tsare hanyar Kano har gari ya waye.
translation: The colonel ordered the soldiers to hold the Kano road until daybreak.

sentence: Mutanen ƙauyen sun yaba wa kanar saboda ya gina musu babbar rijiya.
translation: The villagers praised the colonel because he built them a proper well.

sentence: Kakana ya girma a Zazzau, shi ya sa Hausarsa take da tsafta ƙwarai.
translation: My grandfather grew up in Zaria, which is why his Hausa is so clean.

sentence: Masu yawon buɗe ido suna ziyartar tsohon garun Zazzau duk lokacin bikin sallah.
translation: Tourists come to see the old city wall of Zaria every Sallah festival.

sentence: Ina alfahari da tarihin Zazzau, musamman labarin Sarauniya Amina da yaƙe-yaƙenta.
translation: I am proud of Zazzau's history, above all the story of Queen Amina and her campaigns.

sentence: Inna tana dafa tuwon shinkafa a murhu tun kafin mu tashi daga barci.
translation: Mother is already cooking rice tuwo on the hearth before we are even out of bed.

sentence: Duk lokacin da na koma ƙauye, inna takan aike ni kasuwa da safe.
translation: Every time I go back to the village, mother sends me to the market first thing in the morning.

sentence: Ban gaya wa inna ba cewa na faɗi jarrabawar, don kada ta damu.
translation: I never told mother I had failed the exam, so that she would not worry.

sentence: Malamin makaranta ya ba mu nasiha kan yadda za mu kula da lokaci.
translation: The teacher gave us good advice on how to look after our time.

sentence: Kafin in tafi Legas, baba ya zauna ya yi mini nasiha mai tsawo.
translation: Before I left for Lagos, my father sat me down and gave me a long talking-to.

sentence: Da na saurari nasihar abokina, da ban rasa kuɗina a wannan kasuwanci ba.
translation: If I had listened to my friend's advice, I would not have lost my money in that business.

sentence: Ɗan uwana yana karatun likitanci a Pakistan tun bara, yana kuma jin Urdu.
translation: My brother has been studying medicine in Pakistan since last year, and he speaks Urdu now too.

sentence: Yawancin riguna da muke saya a kasuwar Sabon Gari daga Pakistan suke zuwa.
translation: Most of the clothes we buy in Sabon Gari market come from Pakistan.

sentence: Mun yi murna sosai lokacin da Pakistan ta doke Indiya a wasan kurket.
translation: We celebrated wildly the day Pakistan beat India in the cricket match.
