sentence: Shugabanmu ya ce aikinka ya fi na kowa kyau a wannan watan.

sentence: Idan ba ka son aikinka, me ya sa ba ka neman wani?

sentence: Mun jira motar Kano awa biyu a tasha kafin ta iso.

sentence: Likita ya ce mu jira a waje har sai ya kira sunanmu.

sentence: Ba zan ƙara jira ba, domin na gaji da alkawarinsa na ƙarya.

sentence: Yin barci da wuri yana da muhimmanci ga yaran da ke makaranta.

sentence: A wurin aiki, sadarwa tsakanin maʼaikata tana da muhimmanci fiye da kuɗi.

sentence: A ganina, kuɗi ba shi da muhimmanci idan ka rasa lafiyar jikinka.

sentence: Mahaifiyata ta shirya kyakkyawan abinci na Sallah, ƙamshinsa ya cika gidan.

sentence: Sabon likitan asibitinmu yana da kyakkyawan hali wajen sauraron marasa lafiya.

sentence: Ina fatan wannan shekarar za ta kawo mana kyakkyawan sakamako a jarrabawa.

sentence: Ban taɓa ganin ruwan sama irin wannan ba tun da aka haife ni.

sentence: Kada ka taɓa tukunyar da ke kan wuta, za ka ƙone hannunka.

sentence: Ƙaramin ɗana yana jin tsoron duhu, don haka nakan bar fitila a ɗakinsa.

sentence: Manoma sun girbe gero da wuri saboda tsoron ruwan sama mai yawa.

sentence: Tsoron kasawa ne ya sa ban shiga gasar rubutu ta bara ba.

sentence: Kakata takan bada labarin yaƙi kafin mu kwanta barci kowane dare.

sentence: Shugaban ƙauyen ya bada umarni a gyara rijiyar kafin damina ta zo.

sentence: Ba na son bada shawara ga wanda ba ya son a soki shi.

sentence: Wannan ƙaramin shago ya zama masomin kasuwancin mahaifina shekaru talatin da suka wuce.

sentence: Malamin ya ce sanin haruffa shi ne masomin karatu ga kowane ɗalibi.

sentence: Ina ganin rashin haƙuri shi ne masomin duk rikicin da ya faru a gidanmu.
translation: I think impatience is the root of every quarrel we've had in this house.

sentence: Ɗana ɗalibi ne a Jamiʼar Bayero, yana zaune a masaukin ɗalibai.

sentence: Kowane ɗalibi da ya makara zai share ajin kafin ya shiga.

sentence: Na fi son zama ɗalibi da yake tambaya fiye da wanda ke shiru.
translation: I would rather be the student who asks questions than the one who sits in silence.

sentence: Motar mahaifina ba ta tashi ba sai mun tura ta har ƙarshen titi.

sentence: Direban motar ya ƙi tashi sai fasinjoji sun cika kujeru duka.

sentence: Ban taɓa son motar kanwata ba domin kullum tana kwana a wurin makaniki.
translation: I never liked my little sister's car, because it spends every night at the mechanic's.

sentence: Ba na gani sosai da dare, don haka nakan kunna fitila da wuri.
translation: I don't see well after dark, so I light the lamp early.

sentence: Malam ya ɗaga littafin sama don kowa a aji ya gani.

sentence: Ka jira kaɗan, za ka gani da kanka yadda kasuwar take da cunkoso.

sentence: Idan jikoki suka zo hutu, kakata takan dafa musu koko kowace safiya.
translation: When the grandchildren come for the holidays, my grandmother makes them millet gruel every morning.

sentence: Shugaban ƙauyen ya bayyana musu dalilin da ya sa aka rufe kasuwa.
translation: The village head explained to them why the market had been shut down.

sentence: Na yi alkawari zan saya musu littattafai, amma ban sami kuɗi ba.
translation: I promised I would buy them books, but I never came up with the money.

sentence: Zo mana, abincin ya yi sanyi muna jiranka tun ƙarfe bakwai.
translation: Do come — the food has gone cold and we've been waiting for you since seven.

sentence: Kada ku yi hayaniya mana, jaririn yana barci a ɗakin gaba.
translation: Please don't make a racket — the baby is asleep in the front room.

sentence: Baba ya kawo mana goro da alewa bayan ya dawo daga Kano.
translation: Father brought us kola nuts and sweets after he got back from Kano.

sentence: Kin manta da kashe fitila kafin ki fita zuwa kasuwa.
translation: You forgot to put out the lamp before you went off to the market.

sentence: Kin gama wanke kwanoni ko har yanzu kina cikin girki?
translation: Have you finished washing the dishes, or are you still in the middle of cooking?

sentence: Kin taimake ni sosai a ranar aure, ban san yadda zan gode ba.
translation: You helped me so much on the wedding day that I don't know how to thank you.

sentence: Wa ya bar ƙofar gida a buɗe har dare ya yi?
translation: Who left the front gate standing open right up until nightfall?

sentence: Wa kuka zaɓa ya wakilci makarantar a gasar tambayoyi ta ƙasa?
translation: Who did you pick to represent the school at the national quiz competition?

sentence: Ban sani ba wa ya faɗa masa, amma yanzu unguwa duka ta sani.
translation: I don't know who told him, but by now the whole neighbourhood knows.

sentence: Motarsa ta ƙi tashi da safe, sai ya ɗauki babur zuwa aiki.
translation: His car wouldn't start that morning, so he took a motorbike to work.

sentence: Yakan wanke motarsa da safe kowace Jumaʼa kafin ya tafi masallaci.
translation: He washes his car every Friday morning before heading to the mosque.

sentence: Yana alfahari da motarsa sosai har ba ya barin kowa ya taɓa ta.
translation: He is so proud of his car that he won't let anyone lay a hand on it.

sentence: Yara sukan yi wasa a gaban gida har rana ta faɗi.
translation: The children usually play out in front of the house until the sun goes down.

sentence: Manoma sukan tashi da ƙarfe biyar don su isa gona kafin zafi.
translation: Farmers normally get up at five so as to reach the fields before the heat.

sentence: Abokaina sukan yi mini dariya domin ba na iya tuƙi har yanzu.
translation: My friends always laugh at me because I still can't drive.

sentence: Me kake dafawa a kicin da ƙamshinsa ya cika gidan gaba ɗaya?
translation: What are you cooking in the kitchen? The smell of it has filled the whole house.

sentence: A ina kake aiki yanzu, tun da ka bar kamfanin?
translation: Where are you working these days, now that you've left the company?

sentence: Don me kake zaman shiru tun da muka dawo daga asibiti?
translation: Why have you been so silent ever since we got back from the hospital?

sentence: Waccan tukunya ta fi girma, ki yi amfani da ita don tuwo.
translation: That pot over there is bigger — use that one for the tuwo.

sentence: Waccan mace da ke sayar da ƙosai ita ce maƙwabciyarmu.
translation: That woman over there selling bean cakes is our neighbour.

sentence: Ban amince da waccan hanya ba, tana da ramuka da yawa lokacin damina.
translation: I don't trust that road over there; it is full of potholes in the rainy season.

sentence: Mahaifiyata takan zuba zuma a cikin shayi don ya ƙara zaƙi.
translation: My mother usually stirs honey into the tea to give it more sweetness.

sentence: Mai sayar da mangwaro ya rantse cewa nasa ne mafi zaƙi a kasuwa.
translation: The mango seller swore that his were the sweetest ones in the market.

sentence: Ba na son shayi mai zaƙi sosai, sai idan ina jin rashin lafiya.
translation: I don't like very sweet tea, except when I'm feeling unwell.

sentence: Kafin biki, mun sayi kayan miya duka a kasuwar Kurmi.
translation: Before the wedding we bought all the soup ingredients at Kurmi market.

sentence: Direban ya sauke kayan kasuwanci a gefen titi kafin rana ta yi zafi.
translation: The driver unloaded the trade goods at the roadside before the sun got hot.

sentence: Na gaji da tara kayan yara daga ɗaki zuwa ɗaki kowace maraice.
translation: I'm tired of gathering the children's things from room to room every evening.

sentence: Tun safe ban ci komai ba, sai koko kawai kafin in tafi aiki.
translation: I haven't eaten anything since morning, just some koko before I left for work.

sentence: A jarrabawar, an ce mu amsa tambayoyi biyar kawai daga cikin goma.
translation: In the exam we were told to answer only five of the ten questions.

sentence: Kada ka damu, ƙaramin rauni ne kawai, ba karaya ba.
translation: Don't worry, it's only a small cut, not a broken bone.

sentence: Me kuke dafawa a bakin murhu har ƙamshinsa ya cika unguwarmu?
translation: What are you cooking there on the fire, that the smell has filled our whole neighbourhood?

sentence: Ban san garin da kuke zama ba, amma zan ziyarce ku bayan Sallah.
translation: I don't know the town you live in, but I'll come and visit you after Sallah.

sentence: Wasa kuke yi da lokacinmu, tun safe muke jira a nan.
translation: You're playing games with our time — we've been waiting here since morning.

sentence: Muna cin abinci sai muka ji kiran sallah daga masallacin unguwa.
translation: We were in the middle of eating when we heard the call to prayer from the neighbourhood mosque.

sentence: An gayyace mu zuwa kiran sunan ɗan Malam Sani ranar Lahadi.
translation: We've been invited to the naming ceremony for Malam Sani's son on Sunday.

sentence: Na yi kiran waya sau uku, amma ba ta ɗaga ba har yanzu.
translation: I called her three times on the phone, but she still hasn't picked up.

sentence: Mun daɗe muna jiran mota a tasha har rana ta faɗi.
translation: We waited so long for a vehicle at the motor park that the sun went down.

sentence: Manoma duk suna jiran ruwan sama kafin su fara shuka.
translation: The farmers are all waiting for the rains before they start planting.

sentence: Na gaji da jiran amsar aikin da na nema tun watan Ramadan.
translation: I'm tired of waiting for an answer about the job I applied for back in Ramadan.

sentence: Bana mahaifina ya bar noman gero ya koma noman shinkafa.
translation: This year my father gave up growing millet and switched to rice.

sentence: A Kano, noman rani yana buƙatar famfo da ruwan rijiya kowace rana.
translation: In Kano, dry-season farming needs a pump and well water every single day.

sentence: Matasa da yawa sun ƙi noman ƙasa, sun fi son aikin gwamnati.
translation: Plenty of young people have turned their backs on farming the land; they'd rather have a government job.

sentence: Ƙanena ya fi ni tsayi yanzu, ko da yake ni ne babba.
translation: My younger brother is taller than me now, even though I'm the elder one.

sentence: Mai gyaran rufi ya nemi tsani mai tsayi kafin ya hau rufin gida.
translation: The roofer asked for a tall ladder before he climbed up onto the house.

sentence: Ban samu shiga ƙungiyar ƙwallon kwando ba don ba ni da tsayi sosai.
translation: I didn't get into the basketball team because I'm not very tall.

sentence: Bayan mun dawo daga gona, sai mu huta a ƙarƙashin bishiyar mangwaro.
translation: Once we're back from the farm, we rest under the mango tree.

sentence: Direbobi sukan huta a tasha kafin su ci gaba zuwa Kaduna.
translation: Drivers usually take a break at the motor park before carrying on to Kaduna.

sentence: Tun da na fara wannan aikin, ban huta ko rana ɗaya ba.
translation: Since I started this job, I haven't had a single day off.

sentence: Yara sun dawo daga makaranta suna jin yunwa, amma babu abinci a gida.
translation: The children came home from school hungry, but there was no food in the house.

sentence: A watan Ramadan, yunwa takan kama ni kafin lokacin buda baki.
translation: During Ramadan, hunger gets to me long before it's time to break the fast.

sentence: Yunwa ta yi yawa a ƙauyuka bayan ambaliyar da ta lalata gonaki.
translation: Hunger has spread through the villages since the flood destroyed the farms.

sentence: Na kwana a gidanka jiya, amma ban ga mahaifinka ba.
translation: I stayed the night at your house yesterday, but I never saw your father.

sentence: Gidanka yana kusa da babbar kasuwa, shi ya sa baƙi ba sa ƙarewa.
translation: Your house is right by the big market, which is why the visitors never stop coming.

sentence: Ina son gidanka ƙwarai, domin kowane ɗaki yana da taga mai faɗi.
translation: I really like your house, because every room has a wide window.

sentence: Littafina ya faɗi a cikin taɓo, yanzu shafukansa duk sun ƙazantu.
translation: My book fell in the mud, and now every one of its pages is filthy.

sentence: Malam, na manta littafina a gida, ko zan iya karatu tare da Musa?
translation: Teacher, I left my book at home — may I read along with Musa?

sentence: Wannan littafina ne, kuma ba na son kowa ya rubuta a cikinsa.
translation: This is my book, and I don't want anyone writing in it.

sentence: Kowace safiya yaranmu sukan fita da wuri don su kama motar makaranta.
translation: Every morning our children leave early to catch the school bus.

sentence: Mun tara kuɗi domin gyara makarantar da yaranmu ke karatu a cikinta.
translation: We pooled our money to repair the school our children study in.

sentence: Ina fatan yaranmu za su fi mu saʼa a wannan duniya mai wahala.
translation: I hope our children have better luck than we did in this hard world.

sentence: Rigarki ta jiƙe da ruwan sama, sai ki sauya ta da sauri.
translation: Your gown is soaked through from the rain — go and change it quickly.

sentence: Maɗinki ya ce rigarki za ta shirya kafin ranar bikin ƙanwarki.
translation: The tailor says your gown will be ready before your younger sister's wedding day.

sentence: Rigarki ta fi tawa kyau, launin shuɗin nan ya dace da ke ƙwarai.
translation: Your gown is nicer than mine; that shade of blue really suits you.

sentence: Motarmu tsohuwa ce, amma har yanzu tana kai mu kasuwa kowace Jumaʼa.
translation: Our car is old, but it still gets us to the market every Friday.

sentence: Wata tsohuwa tana sayar da gyaɗa a ƙofar masallaci kowace safiya.
translation: An old woman sells groundnuts at the mosque gate every morning.

sentence: Kada ki yi dariyar tsohuwa, gobe ke ma za ki tsufa.
translation: Don't laugh at an old woman — tomorrow you will be old yourself.

sentence: Mahaifiyata takan tashi kafin asuba ta dafa koko da ƙosai.
translation: My mother always gets up before dawn to cook koko and bean cakes.

sentence: Aisha takan sayar da tumatir a kasuwar Kurmi duk ranar Talata.
translation: Aisha sells tomatoes at Kurmi market every Tuesday.

sentence: Idan ta yi fushi, takan yi shiru har sai fushinta ya huce.
translation: When she gets angry she goes silent until her temper has cooled off.

sentence: Kowace shekara mukan koma ƙauye don mu taimaka wa kakata da noma.
translation: Every year we go back to the village to help my grandmother with the farming.

sentence: Da yamma mukan taru a filin wasa mu buga ƙwallo har magariba.
translation: In the evenings we gather at the pitch and play football until dusk.

sentence: Ko da ba mu da kuɗi, mukan raba abin da muke da shi.
translation: Even when we have no money, we still share whatever we do have.

sentence: Kakan sha shayi da safe, ko kofi ka fi so?
translation: Do you usually drink tea in the morning, or is it coffee you prefer?

sentence: A wurin aiki kakan gama da ƙarfe biyar, amma yau ka daɗe.
translation: At work you normally finish at five o'clock, but today you stayed late.

sentence: Kakan yi alkawari sannan ka karya shi, shi ya sa na gaji.
translation: You keep making promises and then breaking them — that is why I am fed up.

sentence: Wadda ta wanke tukunyar nan ba ta gama ba, ga ƙazanta a ciki.
translation: Whoever washed this pot did not finish the job — there is still dirt inside.

sentence: Ita ce wadda ta lashe gasar rubutu a jamiʼar Bayero bara.
translation: She is the one who won the writing competition at Bayero University last year.

sentence: Duk wadda take son zaman lafiya, ba za ta fara faɗa ba.
translation: Any woman who genuinely wants peace will not be the one to start a quarrel.

sentence: Ban san abin da yaran suke nema a ƙarƙashin gadona ba.
translation: I have no idea what the children are looking for under my bed.

sentence: Me ya sa ʼyan makaranta suke tsaye cikin rana tun safe?
translation: Why have the schoolchildren been standing out in the sun since morning?

sentence: Ina mamakin yadda suke jure zafin Kano ba tare da fanka ba.
translation: I am amazed at how they put up with Kano's heat without a fan.

sentence: Mahaifiyata ta raba kunun gero tsakanin yara biyar kafin su tafi makaranta.
translation: My mother shared out the millet porridge among the five children before they left for school.

sentence: A kasuwar Kano, mun raba kayan zuwa kashi uku don sayarwa.
translation: At the Kano market we divided the goods into three lots to sell.

sentence: Rikicin gado ya raba iyalinsu, kuma har yanzu ba su sasanta ba.
translation: The inheritance quarrel split their family apart, and they still haven't made peace.

sentence: Idan ruwan sama ya tsaya, zamuyi wanki a bayan gida gobe.
translation: If the rain lets up, we'll do the washing out back tomorrow.

sentence: Bayan sallar Jumaʼa, zamuyi taro a gidan sarki don tattauna batun ruwa.
translation: After Friday prayers we'll hold a meeting at the chief's house to discuss the water problem.

sentence: Kada ka damu, zamuyi haƙuri har sai ya dawo daga Legas.
translation: Don't worry — we'll be patient until he gets back from Lagos.

sentence: Kowace safiya nakan kaisu makaranta da keke kafin in tafi aiki.
translation: Every morning I take them to school on the bicycle before I go to work.

sentence: Direban ya kaisu tashar mota, amma motar ta riga ta tashi.
translation: The driver took them to the motor park, but the bus had already pulled out.

sentence: Ina roƙonka ka kaisu asibiti da sauri, zazzaɓinsu bai sauka ba.
translation: I'm begging you to get them to the hospital quickly — their fever hasn't come down.

sentence: Yarana basa cin miyar kuka sai na sa kifi a ciki.
translation: My children won't eat baobab-leaf soup unless I put fish in it.

sentence: Maʼaikatan banki basa aiki ranar Lahadi, don haka sai ka dawo gobe.
translation: Bank staff don't work on Sundays, so you'll have to come back tomorrow.

sentence: Abin takaici, matasa da yawa basa son noma kamar yadda iyayensu suka yi.
translation: Sadly, a lot of young people have no love for farming the way their parents did.

sentence: Ɗakin da muka sauka a ciki ƙazami ne sosai, sai muka wanke shi.
translation: The room we moved into was truly filthy, so we scrubbed it out.

sentence: Rijiyar ƙauyen ta lalace, kuma ruwan da muke sha ƙazami ne.
translation: The village well has fallen into ruin, and the water we drink is filthy.

sentence: Ya yi min ƙarya, sannan ya sace kuɗina — mutumin nan ƙazami ne.
translation: He lied to me and then stole my money — that man is scum.

sentence: Tun jiya kunnena yana ciwo, ban iya kwanciya ba da dare.
translation: My ear has been aching since yesterday; I couldn't lie down all night.

sentence: Ka ɗaga murya kaɗan, don kunnena ba ya ji sosai a cikin hayaniyar kasuwa.
translation: Raise your voice a little, because my ear doesn't hear well in the din of the market.

sentence: A bikin aure, sautin ganga ya cika kunnena har na kasa jin muryarka.
translation: At the wedding the sound of the drums so filled my ear that I couldn't hear your voice.

sentence: Kowane dare mahaifina yakan kashe janareta kafin kowa ya kwanta barci.
translation: Every night my father switches off the generator before everyone goes to bed.

sentence: Maƙwabta sun zo da guga suka kashe wutar da ta tashi a kasuwa.
translation: The neighbours came running with buckets and put out the fire that had broken out in the market.

sentence: Na ji tsoro sosai lokacin da kakana ya kashe maciji a bayan gida.
translation: I was terrified when my grandfather killed a snake behind the house.

sentence: Yarinyar ta canja kayanta sau uku kafin ta fita zuwa bikin ƙawarta.
translation: The girl changed her clothes three times before setting off for her friend's wedding.

sentence: Bayan shekara uku a Kano, ya canja aikinsa ya koma Legas.
translation: After three years in Kano he changed jobs and moved down to Lagos.

sentence: Tun bayan rasuwar mahaifiyarsa, halinsa ya canja gaba ɗaya.
translation: Ever since his mother died, his whole character has changed.

sentence: Ta dafa shinkafa, kuma ta yi miya mai yaji saboda baƙi sun iso.
translation: She cooked rice, and she also made a peppery stew because guests had arrived.

sentence: Malamin ya yabi rubutunta, kuma ya ba ta lambar yabo a gaban ajin.
translation: The teacher praised her writing, and on top of that gave her a prize in front of the class.

sentence: Ba na son wannan aikin, kuma albashin bai isa biyan haya ba.
translation: I don't like this job, and besides, the pay isn't enough to cover the rent.

sentence: Mahaifiyata ta zaɓi launin shuɗi domin a fenta ɗakin baƙi kafin sallah.
translation: My mother chose blue so the guest room could be painted before the festival.

sentence: A kasuwar Kurmi na nemi atamfa mai launin kore, amma duk sun ƙare.
translation: At Kurmi market I looked for a wrapper cloth in green, but they had all sold out.

sentence: Ban taɓa son launin ja a mota ba, yana jan hankalin ʼyan sanda.
translation: I have never liked red on a car — it draws the attention of the police.

sentence: Yau ba mu da wutar lantarki, don haka mun dafa abinci da itace.
translation: There is no electricity today, so we cooked the food over firewood.

sentence: Yau ne ranar kasuwa, saboda haka hanyar zuwa garin ta cika da mutane.
translation: Today is market day, so the road into town is packed with people.

sentence: Yau na gaji sosai, ba zan iya zuwa taron ba; ka yi haƙuri.
translation: I am exhausted today — I won't be able to make the meeting; please forgive me.

sentence: Rigarsa ta yage a wuya, don haka ya kai ta wurin maɗinki.
translation: His gown tore at the neck, so he took it round to the tailor.

sentence: A ranar sallah, Malam Sani ya sa sabuwar rigarsa ya nufi babban masallaci.
translation: On the festival day Malam Sani put on his new gown and set off for the central mosque.

sentence: Rigarsa ta yi masa girma sosai, har yara suna masa dariya a kasuwa.
translation: His gown is far too big for him — the children even laugh at him in the market.

sentence: Hayaƙin wuta ya sa bangon ɗakin girki ya yi baƙi ƙirin.
translation: Smoke from the fire has turned the kitchen wall pitch black.

sentence: Da hadari ya taso, sararin sama ya yi baƙi ƙirin da tsakar rana.
translation: When the storm blew up, the sky went pitch black in the middle of the day.

sentence: Ina son gashin jaririn nan, baƙi ƙirin kamar na mahaifiyarsa.
translation: I love this baby's hair — jet black, just like his mother's.

sentence: Kowace safiya ƙanwata takan shafa mai a gashinta kafin ta tafi makaranta.
translation: Every morning my little sister rubs oil into her hair before she leaves for school.

sentence: Matar ta biya dubu biyu don a kitsa gashinta kafin ranar bikin.
translation: The woman paid two thousand to have her hair braided before the wedding day.

sentence: Ta yi kuka lokacin da likita ya ce dole a aske gashinta.
translation: She burst into tears when the doctor said her hair would have to be shaved off.

sentence: Maƙerin ya cire ƙarfen daga wuta yana ja wur, sai ya fara bugunsa.
translation: The blacksmith drew the iron out of the fire glowing red, then began hammering it.

sentence: Bayan ya kwana yana karatu, idanunsa sun yi ja wur da safe.
translation: After sitting up all night studying, his eyes were blazing red by morning.

sentence: Lallen hannunta ya yi ja wur, har ƙawayenta suka yi kishi.
translation: The henna on her hands came out a brilliant red — her friends were jealous.

sentence: Ya sayo babur sabo ful, amma bai iya tuƙa shi ba tukuna.
translation: He bought a brand-new motorbike, but he still can't ride it.

sentence: A ranar farko ta makaranta, yaron ya zo da takalmi sabo ful.
translation: On the first day of school the boy turned up in brand-new shoes.

sentence: Mai sayarwa ya rantse wayar sabuwa ful ce, amma ban yarda ba.
translation: The seller swore the phone was brand new, but I didn't believe him.

sentence: Bayan ruwan sama, randar da ke bakin ƙofa ta cika fal.
translation: After the rain, the water pot by the doorway was filled right to the brim.

sentence: Kowace Jumaʼa masallacin unguwarmu yakan cika fal da masu sallah.
translation: Every Friday our neighbourhood mosque fills up completely with worshippers.

sentence: Ina jin haushi domin motar haya ta cika fal kafin in isa tasha.
translation: I'm annoyed because the minibus was packed full before I even reached the stop.

sentence: Tsohuwar motarmu ta tsaya a kan hanya, sai muka tura ta gida.
translation: Our old car broke down on the road, so we pushed it home.

sentence: Tsohuwar makarantar da na yi karatu a ciki ta rushe bara.
translation: The old school I studied in collapsed last year.

sentence: Ba na son a sayar da tsohuwar gonar kakanmu ko kaɗan.
translation: I don't want our grandfather's old farm sold, not one bit.

sentence: Malam Sani yana koyar da lissafi a makarantar sakandare da ke garinmu.
translation: Malam Sani teaches maths at the secondary school in our town.

sentence: Kakata ta koyar da ni yadda ake dafa miyar kuka tun ina ƙarama.
translation: My grandmother taught me how to cook baobab-leaf soup when I was still little.

sentence: Ina ganin ya kamata a koyar da yara harshen Hausa tun suna ƙanana.
translation: I think children should be taught Hausa while they are still young.

sentence: Shinkafar da na dafa jiya ta ƙone saboda na manta da ita.
translation: The rice I cooked yesterday burned because I forgot all about it.

sentence: Mun sayar da shinkafar gonarmu duka a kasuwar Dawanau ranar Litinin.
translation: We sold all the rice from our farm at Dawanau market on Monday.

sentence: Shinkafar Kano ta fi ta ƙasashen waje daɗi, in ji mahaifiyata.
translation: Kano rice tastes better than the imported kind, according to my mother.

sentence: Gidan da muka saya bai ginu da kyau ba, ganuwar tana tsagewa.
translation: The house we bought wasn't properly built — the wall is already cracking.

sentence: Rijiyar da ƙungiyar matasa suka haƙa ta ginu da siminti mai ƙarfi.
translation: The well the youth association dug was lined with strong cement.

sentence: Mun yi farin ciki ƙwarai da asibitin ya ginu kafin damina ta zo.
translation: We were delighted that the clinic got built before the rainy season arrived.

sentence: ʼYar ƙanwata tana zuwa makaranta da keke kowace safiya.
translation: My younger sister's daughter rides a bicycle to school every morning.

sentence: ʼYar jaridar ta yi hira da manoma game da hauhawar farashin taki.
translation: The journalist interviewed the farmers about the rising price of fertiliser.

sentence: Mahaifina yana alfahari da ni domin na zama ʼyar kasuwa mai nasara.
translation: My father is proud of me because I have become a successful businesswoman.

sentence: Yaran unguwa suna buga ƙwallo a filin da ke bayan masallaci.
translation: The neighbourhood boys are playing football on the field behind the mosque.

sentence: Kocin ya ce ba za mu buga ƙwallo ba sai mun gama jarabawa.
translation: The coach said we would not play football until we had finished the exams.

sentence: Ina son kallon ƙwallo, amma mahaifina ya fi son ganin ina karatu.
translation: I love watching football, but my father would much rather see me studying.

sentence: Na sayo maganin zazzaɓi daga kantin magani da ke gaban asibiti.
translation: I bought fever medicine from the pharmacy opposite the hospital.

sentence: Manoman ƙauyen sun haɗa kuɗi suka sayi maganin kashe kwari na gonakinsu.
translation: The village farmers pooled their money and bought insecticide for their farms.

sentence: Ilimi kaɗai ne maganin jahilci, ba dukiya ba, in ji malaminmu.
translation: Education alone is the cure for ignorance, not wealth, as our teacher says.

sentence: Nisan da ke tsakanin gidanmu da makaranta bai wuce kilomita biyu ba.
translation: The distance between our house and the school is no more than two kilometres.

sentence: Direban ya gaya mana nisan hanyar Kano zuwa Sakkwato kafin mu tashi.
translation: The driver told us the distance of the Kano to Sokoto road before we set off.

sentence: Duk da nisan tafiya, na kai wa kakata gaisuwa ranar Sallah.
translation: Despite how far the journey was, I went to greet my grandmother on Sallah day.

sentence: Mangwaro ya faɗo kan rufin ɗakinmu da tsakar dare, sai muka firgita.
translation: A mango came down on our roof in the dead of night and we were startled.

sentence: Buhun gyada ya faɗo daga motar dako, sai masu sayarwa suka taru.
translation: A sack of groundnuts fell off the delivery truck and the traders gathered round.

sentence: Ina jin tsoro duk lokacin da na tuna yadda na faɗo daga bene.
translation: I still feel afraid whenever I remember falling from the upper floor.

sentence: Jiya da safe mahaifiyata ta kai jariri asibiti domin a yi masa rigakafi.
translation: Yesterday morning my mother took the baby to the hospital to have him vaccinated.

sentence: Maʼaikatan lafiya sun zo ƙauyenmu ranar kasuwa domin su yi wa yara rigakafi.
translation: The health workers came to our village on market day to vaccinate the children.

sentence: Kakana bai yarda da rigakafi ba sai da ya ga yadda ya taimaki jikokinsa.
translation: My grandfather had no faith in vaccination until he saw how it helped his grandchildren.

sentence: Kada ka daɗe a kasuwa, saboda abincin dare zai yi sanyi.
translation: Don't be long at the market, or the evening meal will go cold.

sentence: Mun daɗe muna jiran direba a tashar mota har rana ta faɗi.
translation: We waited a long time for a driver at the motor park, right until sunset.

sentence: Na daɗe ban ga abokaina na makarantar sakandare ba, ina jin kewarsu.
translation: It has been ages since I saw my secondary-school friends, and I miss them.

sentence: Manomin ya sunkuya gaban alƙali ya ce, ‘Ranka ya daɗe, an sace mini shanu.’
translation: The farmer bowed before the judge and said, ‘Long life to you — my cattle have been stolen.’

sentence: Ka kula da lafiyarka, ranka ya fi kuɗin duniya daraja.
translation: Look after your health; your life is worth more than all the money in the world.

sentence: A gaban sarki, kowa yakan fara da ‘Ranka ya daɗe’ kafin ya yi magana.
translation: Before the emir, everyone opens with ‘Long may you live’ before saying anything.

sentence: Ka gode wa maƙwabciyarmu da ta kawo mana abinci jiya da yamma.
translation: Thank our neighbour for bringing us food yesterday evening.

sentence: Bayan aikin, ɗalibai sun gode wa malaminsu don haƙurin da ya yi.
translation: After the work was done, the students thanked their teacher for his patience.

sentence: Na gode ƙwarai; da ba don ku ba, da na kwana a hanya.
translation: Thank you so much; if it weren't for you, I'd have spent the night on the road.

sentence: Baƙonmu ya iso da daddare, sai muka shirya masa ɗaki da katifa.
translation: Our guest arrived late at night, so we got a room and a mattress ready for him.

sentence: Baƙonmu daga Sakkwato zai yi jawabi a bikin auren ɗan uwana gobe.
translation: Our guest from Sokoto will give the speech at my brother's wedding tomorrow.

sentence: A gidanmu, ba mu barin baƙonmu ya ci abinci shi kaɗai ba.
translation: In our house we never let our guest eat by himself.

sentence: Ni fa ban ci abinci ba tun safe, ku bar mini ɗan tuwo.
translation: As for me, I haven't eaten since morning — leave me a little tuwo.

sentence: Yau fa kasuwa ba za ta buɗe ba, don haka mu je gobe.
translation: Today, mind you, the market won't open, so let's go tomorrow instead.

sentence: Kai fa ka manta alkawarinka, tun makon jiya nake jiran kuɗina.
translation: You, for your part, have forgotten your promise — I've been waiting for my money since last week.

sentence: Ban san inda na ajiye makullin gida ba, mun kwana muna nema.
translation: I don't know where I put the house key; we spent the whole night looking for it.

sentence: Direban nan ya san kowace hanya a Kano tun kafin a gina sabuwar gada.
translation: That driver has known every road in Kano since before the new bridge was built.

sentence: Na san ka gaji, amma ka ɗan ƙara haƙuri kafin mota ta zo.
translation: I know you're tired, but be patient a little longer until the bus comes.

sentence: Yara sun ɓoye wayoyi a ƙarƙashin katifa don kada mahaifinsu ya gani.
translation: The children hid their phones under the mattress so that their father wouldn't see them.

sentence: Bayan hadarin jiya, maʼaikatan NEPA suna gyara wayoyi a titinmu tun da sassafe.
translation: After yesterday's storm, the electricity workers have been repairing wires on our street since dawn.

sentence: A ganina, wayoyi sun raba mutane da zaman tare a gidajenmu.
translation: In my view, phones have robbed people of the togetherness we used to have at home.

sentence: Da na shiga gida, sai na ji kamshi mai daɗi daga girkin mahaifiyata.
translation: As I stepped into the house, a wonderful aroma reached me from my mother's cooking.

sentence: A kasuwar turare, kowane shago yana da kamshi da ke jan abokan ciniki.
translation: In the perfume market, every shop has a scent that pulls customers in.

sentence: Bayan ruwan sama, ƙasa takan yi kamshi da nake so tun ina yaro.
translation: After rain the earth gives off a smell I have loved since I was a boy.

sentence: Tagwayen maƙwabcinmu sun bambanta sosai, ko da yake fuskokinsu ɗaya ne.
translation: Our neighbour's twins are completely different from each other, even though their faces are identical.

sentence: Malamin ya koya mana yadda za mu bambanta ƙaramin harafi da babban harafi.
translation: The teacher taught us how to tell a small letter from a capital one.

sentence: Rayuwa a Legas ta bambanta da ta ƙauyenmu, kuma har yanzu ban saba ba.
translation: Life in Lagos is different from life in our village, and I still haven't got used to it.

sentence: Ɗakin girkinmu ba shi da fadi, don haka mahaifiyata takan dafa abinci a waje.
translation: Our kitchen isn't wide, so my mother usually cooks outside.

sentence: Malam ya ce mu auna fadi da tsawon ajin kafin darasin lissafi.
translation: The teacher told us to measure the width and length of the classroom before the maths lesson.

sentence: Na fi son sabon masallacin domin ya fi tsohon fadi da kyau.
translation: I prefer the new mosque because it is wider and finer than the old one.

sentence: Kowace safiya kakana yakan sha bakin shayi ba tare da sukari ba.
translation: Every morning my grandfather drinks his tea black, with no sugar.

sentence: Dokar makaranta ce kowane ɗalibi ya sa bakin takalma da farin kaya.
translation: It is the school rule that every pupil wears black shoes and white clothes.

sentence: Bakin ciki ya kama ni lokacin da na ji labarin rasuwar maƙwabcinmu.
translation: Grief took hold of me when I heard the news of our neighbour's death.

sentence: Bayan makaranta ƙanena yakan je kiwon awaki har faɗuwar rana.
translation: After school my younger brother goes out to graze the goats until sunset.

sentence: Saboda ƙarancin ruwa, makiyaya sun koma kudu don neman wurin kiwon shanunsu.
translation: Because of the water shortage, the herders moved south looking for grazing land for their cattle.

sentence: A ganina, kiwon kaji ya fi noman gero sauƙi da riba a ƙauyenmu.
translation: In my view, keeping chickens is easier and more profitable than growing millet in our village.

sentence: A gidanmu, mahaifiyata ce take da ikon yanke shawara kan kuɗin abinci.
translation: In our house it is my mother who has the authority to decide about the food money.

sentence: Manaja kaɗai ne yake da ikon sallamar maʼaikaci a wannan kamfani.
translation: Only the manager has the power to dismiss a worker in this company.

sentence: Likitoci sun yanke ƙauna, amma ikon Allah ya sa yaron ya warke.
translation: The doctors had given up hope, but by God's power the boy recovered.

sentence: Na ari baburin ɗan uwana don in kai mahaifiyata asibiti da dare.
translation: I borrowed my cousin's motorbike to take my mother to the hospital at night.

sentence: Ki ari littafin lissafi wurin Amina kafin jarrabawar gobe ta fara.
translation: Borrow the maths book from Amina before tomorrow's exam begins.

sentence: Na ƙi in ari kuɗi wurin maƙwabta, saboda haka na sayar da awakina.
translation: I refused to borrow money from the neighbours, so I sold my goats instead.

sentence: Kowace safiya yara sukan shiga ɗakin kaka don gaisuwa kafin su tafi makaranta.
translation: Every morning the children go into grandmother's room to greet her before they leave for school.

sentence: Ɗan uwana da ke Legas ya aiko da gaisuwa ga dukan mutanen ƙauyenmu.
translation: My relative in Lagos has sent his greetings to everyone in our village.

sentence: Na ji haushi domin ya wuce ni ba tare da gaisuwa ba.
translation: I was annoyed because he walked straight past me without a greeting.

sentence: Ko na yi maka fushi, ka sani ina sonka fiye da kowa.
translation: Even when I am angry with you, know that I love you more than anyone.

sentence: Yarinyar ta ce ba ta sonka domin ba ka da aikin yi.
translation: The girl said she does not love you because you have no job.

sentence: Sonka ya sa na bar aikina a Kano, na bi ka Legas.
translation: Loving you made me leave my job in Kano and follow you to Lagos.

sentence: Mahaifiyata ta tashi da ƙarfe biyar don ta shirya abincin sallah.
translation: My mother got up at five o'clock to prepare the food for the festival.

sentence: Kwamitin ya shirya taron manoma a ƙarƙashin bishiya saboda babu wutar lantarki.
translation: The committee arranged the farmers' meeting under a tree because there was no electricity.

sentence: Ban gama shirya kayana ba tukuna, alhali motar Kano za ta tashi yanzu.
translation: I haven't finished packing my things yet, and the Kano bus is about to leave.

sentence: Kudan zuma ya yi masa harbi a wuya, sai fuskarsa ta kumbura.
translation: A bee stung him on the neck, and his face swelled up.

sentence: Mun ji ƙarar harbi a kasuwa, sai kowa ya fara gudu.
translation: We heard the sound of a gunshot in the market, and everyone started running.

sentence: Ina tsoron harbi tun ranar da ʼyan bindiga suka far wa ƙauyenmu.
translation: I have been afraid of gunfire since the day bandits attacked our village.

sentence: Yaron ya dawo daga wasa da kazamin kaya, mahaifiyarsa kuwa ta yi fushi.
translation: The boy came back from playing in filthy clothes, and his mother was furious.

sentence: Likita ya ce kazamin ruwa ne ya kawo cutar gudawa a ƙauyenmu.
translation: The doctor said it was dirty water that brought the diarrhoea outbreak to our village.

sentence: Na ƙi kwana a kazamin ɗakin da suka nuna mana a masaukin.
translation: I refused to sleep in the filthy room they showed us at the guesthouse.
